rtsomapapongosprod mdor bsdus/tshe rdor/ pho/ bod rigs/ spyi lo 1950lor lha sar sku 'khrungs/ rtsom pa po de nyid slob gra chung 'bring che gsum la slob sbyong gnang myong yod cing / spyi lo 1980lo nas 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉rtsom sgrig khang la rtsom sgrig pa'i phyag las gnang ste lo ngo bcu ba'i song ba'i ring / snga rjes su 'gan khri'i rtsom sgrig pa dang / rtsom sgrig khang gi dbu 'dzin gzhon pa/ rtsom sgrig khang gi dbu 'dzin bcas kyi thugs
'argan bzhes myong yo da/ da lta khong bod ljongs rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyi kru'u 'i gzhon pa yin/ dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu 'go tshugs pa nas rtsom pa po de nyid kyis bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig nang gtso bo rtsom sgrig gi phyag las gnang ste rtsom pa po gso skyong bya rgyur phan nus thon pa'i phyag las gnang yod cing / zhor du bod rgya yig rigs gnyis thog nas rig rtsom brtsams chos sna tshogs dus deb tshags par thog spel myong yod/ da dung rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi phyag las gnang ste spyi lo 1993lor skabs bzhi pa'i rgyal yo ngas grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gzengs bstod bya dga'i nang yig sgyur bya dga' thob myong yod/
can 'gro'igatam/〈〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po'i dpe tshogs 'don thengs gnyis pa 〉〉de ni bod kyi deng dus rtsom pa po yar rgyas 'tshar longs byung ste deng dus rtsom rig gi rnam pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba'i skabs dang / lhag par bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo sum cu 'khor ba'i dus ston la rten 'brel zhu ched bod ljongs rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyis ched mngags dpe sgrig byas pa yin/ tang gi skabs bcu 5gcig pa'i krung yu tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs tshun/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig de nyid bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i srid jus bzang po'i khrod du bskyed bsrings 'tshar longs byung ste da cha grub 'bras chen po thob yod/ 〈〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po'i dpe tshogs 'don thengs dang po〉〉de dpar skrun 'grems spel byas pa nas da bar lo ngo bzhi tsam song 'ing / de'i ring bod yig thog nas brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras gcig dpe bskrun 'grems spel zin pa dang / brtsams sgrung ring gras khag gnyis da lta dus deb thog 'god mus yin pa da lo legs grub zin rgyu red/ de ba'in rtsom rig gi rnam ga'ag brtsams
sgrung / snyan ngag lhug rtsom/ dpyad brjod/ sgyur rtsom la so sas par brtsams chos spus legs mang dag cig thon dang thon mus yin pa bcas kyis bod kyi bod yig thog nas brtsams pa'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya ba de nyid la dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas pa lta bu'i rnam pa zhig thon bzhin 'dug snyam/ thengs 'dir 〈〈bod kyi deng dus rtsom pa po'i dpe tshogs 'don thengs gnyis pa〉〉dngos su dpe bskrun byas pa'i rig rtsom dpe deb drug po de ni brjod bya'i nang don zab la rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba bde ba/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i tshad mtho'i rtsom rtsal ldan pa bcas gang sa nas deng dus rtsom pa po'i chu tshad dngos su mtshon pa zhig snang /dus rabs kyis blo ldan rtsom pa po tshor yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro rgyu'i go skabs shin tu bzang po zhig bskrun yod pa de nga tsho'i mig 'bras lta bu gces 'dzin gnang ste dus rabs nyi shu'i mtha' mjug gi lo shas ring nga tshos dka' spyad 'bad brtson/ snying rus chen pos phul byung rig rtsom brtsams chos mang po gsar rtsom gnang nas dus rabs nyer gcig par bsu ba gzab rgyas zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa 'chang bzhin yod/dmatshogasartsomasgrig yuyon lhanakhanganas/spyi lo 1995lo'i ba3pa'i ches15nyin/
—lha ldan bar bskor gyimathong thos (1)lha sa'i kha che/ (23)bod kyi deng rabs rig rtsal gyi gzhung lugs 'ib dpyod tshosas 'dur zhugs pa 'i myong tshor phran bu/ (58)zho ston gyi rnam pa/ ji (68)bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor gleng ba/ (72)bod kyi snga rtsom 〈〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉〉la dpyad pa/ (110)snyan 'jebs rna ba'i bu ram/ (129)dpyad brjod de pho'i nam brda/ (144)ka bshad 〈〈padma 'dab rgyas 〉〉bltas pa'i rjes kyi myong tshor/ (161)rtsom ris dang snyan ngag tha dad yin mam / (173)snyan dngags kyi srog skor gleng ba/ (1941)bod kyi rtsom rig dang rtsom rig yig sgyur
la dpyad pa rags tsam byas pa/ (211)grogs po tshor 'bul ba'i 'phrin yig (275)shes bya thor bu/ (ge 83 )1 gro bsro phye mar/2ri dar lcog3 nyi zla g.yung drung /4na nor bu dga' 'khyil/5 ri dgas chos 'khor/
1mtha' bzhi gangs ris bskor ba snyo ṭa'i yul/sa mtho rlung gtsang chu klung chen po'i 'gorab dkar gangs ris mthon mthing nam mkha' 'degs/bgrang yas mtshe'u maṇḍal gcal ltar bkrams/zhing thang gshin po nam mkha'i khyon yangs por/khyung dkar mdzo pos rgod po'i rtsal la 'gran/mu med rtswa thang g.yu yi gzhongs pa ru/dkar nag phyugs zog mdzes pa'i phra rgyan btabs/kha ba'i ljongs kyi nya lcibs khog yangs por/legs par sbrums pa'i lha ldan mu tig phreng /lang tsho'i sgeg chos rmad byung sa'i go la/ri dwags mig can ma yi mgul du sgron/— 1 —
skyed chu sngo na po nub kyi phyogs su rgyugs/sdo ༵༵ dzo ghnā hā dzo/spyashā 54 ra zlo sna da/ ca' ba/de yi steng du gru 'dzin sanyis pa bzhings/ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i po tā la/sprin gyi gseb nas rgya phibs 'od zer spro/srid pa'i rtse mor snyan pa 'i ba dan rgayo/phyogs bzhi'i skye bo ma 'bod par ya nga 'du/'dzam gling rgyan cis pho brang po tā la/mtshar sdug kun gyi snying po gcig tu bsdus /ngo mtshar rmad byung gzi byin dpal 'bar ba'i/khyed 'a ra lan brgyar mjal yang ngom pa med/bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i srid jus nyin byed casal/rang dbang ljongs rgyu'i pad dkar 'dab ma grol/dkar ser nag gsum mi rigs tha dad kyi/gang zag du mas gang gi 'bas la btud/2 —
lha sa zhes bya gna' bo'i grong 'di la/gna' bo'i shul rdzas mang bas grags pa che/phyi gling ba tsho'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrogmtha' yas rgya mtsho sgrol te gnas 'dir chas/g.yu 'brug sngon po rlabs kyi ral pa gsigzhing bzang lha ldan gzhung 'di mdzes pa'i rgyan/sangasari rngul ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab/grong mir bde skyid sgrun byed ma ma khyed/gtsang chab sngon po skyed ma'i nu zho ba'in/ring mo nyid nas bdag cag drin gyis bskyangs/ mes pos gang gi bka' drin gso ba'i phyir/skyid chu zhes bya'i mtshan bzang legs par gsol/mi lo chig stong sum brgya'i sngon rol nas/mi rje chen po srong btsan sgam po mchogyul 'di'i thun min khyad chos legs gzigs nas/mkhar du bzhes te yul ming lha sa thogs/— 3 —
mtho ris skyid pa'i zhing khams sa 'dir 'phos/dge ba'i legs tshogs thams cad 'di na 'khyil/zhing 'dir 'khod pa'i dad ldan gang zag kyang /bsod nams can zhes kun gyi yid smon skye/sa yi go la zlum po'i rtse mo ru/bkod legs ba gam cod pan bzhin du brtsegs/'jig rten byed po tshangs pas gzigs pa na/khengs pa 'jom ste phrag pa lhug ger glod/rab dkar bkod legs khang bzang ltar du chags/sham bu nag ris sge'u khung mdzes par brgyan/yang steng tshon sna'i dar lcog phyogs bzhir btsugs/thun min snyo ṭa'i khyad chos 'di na thon/lo ltar gnam lo gsar du ba'ad pa'i tshe/dkar rag gsol 'ing dar lcog gsar du baje/rlung rta yar bskyed gegs dbang bar chad bzlograb mdzes tshon snas lha ldan grong khyer brgyan/— 4 —
= skar dbus su rgyu skar rgyal po nyid/bzhugs pa lta bu'i lha ldan gtsug lag khang /ba da chags nyams dga'i bkod legs ba gam can/mjal ba tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yos/rab dkar rdo thal bskus pa'i phyi brtsegs la/spen pad sprug pos mtha' bzhi rab tu brgyan/gnag snum nag 6sa sge'u khung mdzes pa'i steng /dkar dkar sham bu'i sul ris 'thul ler 'phyung /rin chen gser zangs rgya pheb rnam par mdzes/'phyung 'phrul dril po'i dbyangs snyan rna bar 'jebs/shang shang bya yis bkra shis gshog zung brkyangs/ri dgas bse rus chos kyi 'khor lor gtad/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gan ji ra yi togsngo bsangs mkha' la 'khyog min srong por bsgrengs/rin chen byur bur gtam pa'i bsod nams gzhong /bkra shis dge mtshan ma lus g.yas su 'khyil/— 5 —
rwa sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi dbus/rten gyi gtso bo sha kya mu ri bzhugs/chol kha gsum gyi dad ldan bod mi tsho'i/lhag bsam zol med dad pa'i rten gcig pu/skyid pa'i pha yul byams pa'i pha ma dang /brtse ba'i dga' nye spun grogs ring du bskyur/brkyangs phyag phul te la klung du ma brgal/ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba'i 'bas la gtugs/dad sems 'o ma bsrubs pa'i snying po mar/kong du phul te ma rig mun pa sel/sor mo'i 'dab ma snying khar rab bkod nas/'di phyi bde ba thob pa'i smon lam btabs/steng shod bar gsum chos mjal legs par zhus/dad pa'i stobs kyis sems la bde ba thob/jo khang sgo thon sgo 'phyor 'og tu slebs/jo bo'i dbu skur 'bod pa'i rgya lcang mthong /— 6 —
de yi 'gram du khrang ching rdo ring bzhugs/khri ral dus su rgya bod blon chen gros/nam nam 'ar 'ar 'tshe med bro bor ba/rdo la ri mo brkos te sa 'dir bslangs bar bskor khrom mang tshogs pa'i do ra ma/'dra min skad kyis kur 'ur 'bum skad sgrogs/khra khra sil sil rgya zog bod zog bkrams/bstor ba'i zhor du rang mkho'i zog rnams bsgrubs/'dzam bugling 'dir khrom ra grangs las 'das/phyi skor nang smor rang rang gang 'dod basmor/bar bskor khrom 'di bod pas nang smor basbor/basmor basmor 'dra yang thun min khyad chos ldan/phyas 'tshal skor sbyong dge las bsgrubs pa'i sams /bza' btung 'tsho byed mkho rgu bsgrubs sa'i yu 'a/bar skor 'du 'dzi 'khrus po nyams dga' ba sum rtsen gams la yod dam e ma mtshar/—— 7 ——
yig drug bgrangs ba'i chos kyi sgra lhang lhang /nyo tshong khe gyong rtsod pa'i sgra per ber/ba lu bsregs pa'i bsangs kyi dri 'im po/phyi gling yul gyi dri bzang kha su po/ ①mgrin khug snyan pa'i lha mo'i rnam thar dang /'khrug cha dod pa'i phyi ga'as lda si khor/ ()sngar srol deng srol phyi srol nang gi srol/lugs srol sna tshogs yul dus gcig tu 'dzoms/tob ste bltas na de dag phan tshun dbar/'gal bar gyur te gnas pa'i skabs med kyang /gna' bo'i grong khyer lha ldan bar bskor du/'gal med zhi bar gnas pa e ma ho/2lha ldan gzhung gi bar bskor khrom gzhung thogrgya zog bod zog sna mang tshong zog bshams/gang dgos dngos po ma lus 'di na 'dzoms/'dod 'jo'i ba bzhin kun gyi 'dod 'dun bskongs/— 8 —
shad ma spru phrug snam bu ther ma dang /gos chen dru'u tshe hog se 'bu yi ras/skra snum skra tshos sha gsos dri 'im chu/lag gdub sor gdub skra sping rna yi rgyan/rgya gling dung chen dril bu sgab chal dang /dpe cha phyag phreng thang ga gser zangs sku/mchod kong mchod ting mda' dar lha reg spos/yung dkar dza ti dmar rtsi tig ta tir/zhog khog la phug tshag sha zho 'o ma/'bri mar sog mar shing mar kring gi mar/bod ja mngar ja lbi rag nas kyi chang /bod thug sha mog sha 'bras sha kha tsha/myang zhwa wa zhwa lpags zhwa rgya gar zhwa/ko lham 'gyig lham ras lham spu ma'i lham/dbyar chas dgun chas rgya chas bod kyi chas/mkho rgu ma lus 'dzoms pa'i rnam sras mdzod/— 9 —
khams nas yo nga pa 'i a pho tshong pa tsho/gzugs stobs che 'ing khrom gyi dkyil du langs /'u sa la brgyan pa'i g.yu byur gzi shal ñtsi/rin chen rgyan cha'i nyo tshong byed la brel/thag ring rgya nas yul gyi tshong pa tshos /rgya zog 'a ga tu thogs te bar skor bsto ra/sgra mi dag pa'i bod slad tshig re gnyis/kha nas 'don te tshong zog brim thabs byas /yul 'dir skyes pa 'i tshong pa lha sa bas/tshong khang phye ste tshong zog sgrom du bcugtshong zog brin min snang 'angos cher med pa ra/ca co'i gtam la g.yeng nas dus 'da'o lha sa 'i bar smor khrom lam 'di'i steng du/rgyal khongs mi gcis mi rigs tha dad pa'i/tshong pa 'dzoms kyang la rtsod 'thab mo 'i risas /ris rgyu dkon la tham sa cad 'i bar gnas//——— 1(1 ——
khrom lam dkyil du dge 'dun bso da snyoms bas/rnga sgabs dkrol te 'al ton bar med byed/bar stor skor malan dad ྅ na bod mi tshos/dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gya nom byas/dbang po mi tshang na so cher rgas pa /lto bos phongs te nyam thag gnasal lhung /mthe bong ger nas slong mo'i gral la bzhusas/byang sems can tshos kho tsho bor mi bya/lha lda na gzhung gi byang chub byon lam 'di/tshogs bsasas sgrib ñtsa nga chos 'khor bskor sa'i gnas/lus rte na 'tsho byed lto gos 'tshol sa'i yul/sem sa phung bde ba ster byed nor gyi ma choslha ldan bar bskor khrom lam grags pa che/khron gyi 'du 'dzi 'khrug po tsam ma yin/lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i khang bzang da dra /dar chen mchod rten la sogs 'di rp+pa yod/— 11 —
rwa sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang chen bzhings/sa rdo lhag ma spyad de rab bskrun pa'i/dpal rab khang gsar thog khang gsum brtsegs can/ngo bo dbu skra'i byang gi ngos su bzhugs/bar bskor byang gi khrom lam ring po'i thogmchod rten dkar po ka ṇi sgo ba'i yod/spen pad brgyan pa'i khang chen khrom gzigs khang /bod kyi rgyal po'i gzim shag yin par grags/shar byang mtshams su bslangs ba'i dar po che/dga' ldan dar snyon zhes pa'i ming can thogs/de dang 'dra ba'i dar chen skya rengs shar/bar bskor dung rtse zur gyi khrom du bslangs/bla brang rnying pa bsam grub pho brang dang /rdo ring la sogs sde dpon mi grags kyi/lo rgyus ldan pa'i bkod legs ba gam can/bar bskor lho yi khrom du 'gying nger gnas/— 12 —
lha ldanasmran lam chen mo 'tshogs pa'i dus/bar bskor lho yi gsung chos rwa ba'i steng /dge 'dun mang po 'dus te mtshan nyid rtsod/dga' ldan khri pa mchog gis gsung chos gnang /jus yag dar chen khang chen jus 'ding gling /de snga gtsug lag khang gi nub tu gnas/deng dus ming gi lhag ma tsam yin kyang /rjes rabs mi tshos mkhyen phyir 'di ru smras/bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma'i lo rgyus kyi/don snying ldan pa'i gnas bzang de dag la/shod srol gtam rgyud mang po yod nges kyang /smra ba'i spobs pa blo chung bdag la med/3blo dkar grogs mchog mnyam du 'dzoms pa'i dus/bcud ldan zas dang myos byed btung ba la/bag med spyod de dus tshod 'da' min par/shes rig rtsod gleng bya rgyur spro ba 'phel/— 13 —
rgyal phyi rgyal nang tshan rig chos lugs sogs/gleng ba'i zhor du lha sa'i chags tshul gleng /ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang 'di dang /lha ldan gzhung gnyis sngon du su chags rtsod/rtsod pa 'bab chu 'dra 'dra byas gyur kyang /rtsod mjug gru gu 'gril 'gril ga nas yong /de yang bya dang sgo nga sngon du su byung ba'i/rtsod pa'i gzhi dang gnyis su mi snang ngo /mtha' ma rang rang so po'i khyim tshang 'di/lha sar chags pa'i lo rgyus bshad pa'i tshe/rnyogs ma'i chu 'di nor bu ke ta kus/bgrungs pa'i dpe bzhin rtsod lan je gsal gyur/grogs mchog blo dga'i bzhugs sa sbra nag zhol/pha rgyud ma rgyud mdo smad khams nas yin/mes po'i dus su thag ring pha yul nas/brkyangs phyag phul te gnas mchog lha sar slebs/— 14 —
yul dbus 'byor te dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ston pa zas gtsang sras kyi 'bas la gtusas/phyag 'tshal bskor sbyong tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyang /phugs 'dun bzang po grub pas blo yid tshims/sbra gur phub pa'i khams pa gnas mjal ba/khyu gcig mu gcig lha sa'i shar du gnas/mi rabs mang po sa 'dir gnas bca' bas/sbra nag zhol zhes lha sa'i gling gcig chags/gdon gyis brlams pa'i dbyin ji btsan 'dzung pas/kha ba'i ljongs su drag po'i 'dre lag brkyangs/dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod kyi mi dam ngas tshos/srog la bsdos kyang rang yu la brtan po srung /grogs bzang kun dga' dbang phyug mes po ni/myang smad yu la du 'khrungs pa'i sazhung 'bas yin/tsha drag che ba'i dbyin 'gog dmag 'thab nang /rang srog blos btang byas rjes bla med ba'ag— 15 —
mes po dam pa'i bla med mdzad bzang la/gzengs bstod mtshon byed yab rje go gnas 'phar/khyim gzhi cha tshang lha ldan gzhung la spos/rjes rabs mi rnams lha sa ba la gyur/kho bo'i khyim gyi pha thog bu thog kyang /sa skyes rdo skyes lha sa'i mi ma yin/mes po dam pas dpon g.yog rgyug pa'i skabs/za mkhas 'thung mkhas ma rtsa phran bu bsags/lung chung phag rir khyim gyi rtsa ba tshugs/lam 'grul tshong par zhags sdod gnas tshang g.yar/tshong las dar ba'i rong sa gro mo ru/nyo tshong las la 'bungs bas khyim nor 'phel/khyim tshang dar rgyas yar ngo'i zla la 'gran/bu phrug 'tshar ba dpyid kyi ljang pa'i dpe/dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i drin du dgongs/lha ldan smon lam chen mor dge rtsa bsgrubs/— 16 —
mes po dam pa'i tshe yi 'phen pa zad/nang mi bu phrug skyabs med mgon med gyur/skyar du phag ri phyogs la log bsam yang /yid kyi re bar don gyi 'bras bu dben/'di lta'i ngang du lha sa'i grong du chags/khyim gyi rten ga'i bar skor nang du btsugs/rgya zog bod zog phyir gtong nang 'dren gyi/tshong gi las la brel nas mi tshe bskyal/grogs po gsum pos rang rang khyim tshang gipha mes dus nas lha ldan gzhung 'di la/ji ltar 'byor ba'i lo rgyus bshad pa na/rtsod pa'i mdud pa ma bkrol ngang gis grol/lo ngo stong gcig sum brgya tsam gong du/rgya bza' bal bza' srong btsan khab tu bzhes/mtshan dpe'i gzi sbyin 'bar ba'i jo bo'i sku/lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi rten du 'dren/— 17 —
dad ldan bod mi phyogs ba'i mtshams brgyad nas/ngo bo mjal phyir lha ldan gzhung du slebs/jo lang mtha' bzhir grong khyim ltar du chasas/grags can lha sa'i bar bskor de las grub/gzi brjid dpal gyis phyugs pa'i lha sa ru/rgya mtsho chen por chu phran 'du ba bzhin/chol kha gsum po'i dad ldan bod mi rnams/sanas mchos 'di ru 'du bas e ma mtshar/4'khrug cha che ba'i nyin mo'i b.rabasmor khrom/kun gyis gzigs pas re zhig 'di tsam gleng /bar bskor gzhung gi mtshan dang tho rengs dus/spyi ngo gnam bstan kun gyis sa la shes /rta bdun dbang po chu lta'i phang bar bzhugs/ngur smrigs mdangs ldan mtshams sprin mkha' ru 'phyo/bsangasakhung rtse nas du sprin sngon po 'phyur/bas ngas me'i 'od kyis bar bskor khu mdog 'gyur/ tsho— 18 —
rgya mtsho'i ma ma mkha' ru 'char ba dang /sa gzhi gos can stobs rgyas ral pa gsigde dang chos mtshungs lha ldan bar bskor nang /skye bo du ma 'dus nas bskor ba byas/chos kyi 'ur sgras nam mkha' dbral bar dogs/'bas kyi rdog pas sa ga'i gas par 'jigs/mi grangs 'bum tshogs bskor ba'i lam du zhugs/lha sa'i bar bskor mtsho mo 'khol ba 'dra/nyin byed 'od snang rim bzhin mog por gyur/glog gi sgron me gcig mjug gnyis mthud gsal/dro skyid ldan pa'i khyim tshang so po'i nang /nang mi rgan gzhon brnyan 'phrin ltad mo blta/mun pa'i yol bas nor 'dzin ba'in bzang 'gebs/zang zing che ba'i khrom lam stong par gyur/grang reg rlung bu ldang bas sprang khyi rnams/mjug ma khum ste khrom bkyag 'og tu nyal/— 19 —
nyin mo las la brel ba'i bar bskor yang /ngal bas dub ste rim bzhin gnyid la yur/shin tu dben pa'i mtshan mo'i thun re gnyis/grong mi sdur pa sgrogs pa'i sgra yang thos/tho rengs stag gi snga cha'i dus tsam na/'phrul gyi 'khor lo'i 'ur sgra rgyang nas sgrogs/spos kyi me tshags tshogs kyis mdun bsu ba/yig drug bar med bgrangs ba'i sgra lhang lhang /dga' nye blo dkar ba tshos spos sne drangs/'das po'i phung po jo khang mdun du bzhassor mo'i 'dab ma snying khar rab bkod nas/tshe 'das bar do myur grol smon lam btabs/tshul 'di mthong ba'i na rgas skye bo rnams/'chi ba mi rtag bskul ba'i dril brdar mngon/skyid pa'i mal la zhen pa rab tu spang /'ur te langs nas bar bskor lam la zhugs/— 20 —
skye rga na 'chi'i zhags pa las grol ba'i/'gro ba rigs drug sems ldan gcig med pa/bzu med bden pa'i snying po yid la dran/rnyed dka'i dal 'byor don yod las la brtson/tho rings dus su dri bzhon lhag par bsil/gnyer mas bsnams pa'i 'dren byed gdangs skosko5btsums dka'/zang rdog re re ma ṇi re re bgrangs/dge ba'i lam du zhabs rjes re re ba'agbskor zhing bskor 'ing rkang gnyis bde ru 'gro/bskor zhing bskor zhing lus la tsha drod 'phel/rgad po'i 'bas 'gros rta pho'i 'gros la 'gran/sems dang lus kyi bde ba cig car thob/dbang phyogs lhun po'i rtse nas nyin byed gsal/dge 'phel dbu rtser gser gyi cod pan bsgron/las la brtson pa'i nye 'khor zhing pa tshos/bar bskor nang du zho dang 'o ma btsongs/— 21 —
nyi gzhon dpal dang mtshungs pa'i byis pa tshos/dpe khug rgyab tuspar te slob grwar bskyod/nang gi a maso bsangs khug lag tu thogs/bskor ba'i zhor la bsangs kha bsangs gsol byed/sa ga'i chen po nyi ma'i 'od kyis drod/bar bskor 'du 'dzi 'khrug po'i sgo mo phye/star du chags pa'i tshong khang re re pazhin/sgo pang phye nas 'go tshong las la brel/nyin mos mtshan mthud mtshan mo nyin mor sbrel/nyin zla lo yi srad bur rgyus pa yi/bar bskor khrom gyi lo rgyus phreng ba daglce brgyar sprulayang ma lus brjod par dka'/mchana'agrel/① khasum/ bya la zagazam gzasang/calha malan /② khor sprurgyalargyaskad ba rabyas /lha margyu bsazo'irigsga ga na nga dengaskabasa'adzamaring lamakha la baszo'ade༄bachenamasadagad— 22 —
bhn+ya sal kha rb+ya/snyan grags che ba'i lha sa'i bar skor gyi shar phyosas su spyi khri brgya lhagatsim bskyod na 'dren byed zung du rtse mor tshes gsum zla ba'i dbyibs bkod pa'i mchod rten lta bu'i khang brtsegs mtho po jig dang / sa ngos su rdoms gsum rtsesas steng du rgya bzo'i sgo mo gsum ldan ig gnas thing / sgo byang steng du 'ar pel dang / bod rgya yig rigs gsum thog nas 〈〈kha che'i phyag 'tshal lang 〉〉zhes bzod yod pa de das rim ba'in 'char yong /bzo bkod khyad par can gyi khang pa de tsho mthong dus nga tsho'i yid la de ni i si lam gyi phyas khang yin pa lam seng rtogs thub/lha sa'i kha che'i phyag 'tshal khang 'ji dus ji tsam du bsum pa dang / lha sa'i kha che ji ltar chags pa'i skor la dmigs nas kho bos ched mngags kha che rgan gras tshor bca' dri zhus pa yin/ khong rnam pas 59lo'i zing 'khrus zhod 'jags ma btang gong / phyag 'tshal khang tshang byang bu — 23 —
mang dag cig dang / lo rgyus kyi yig rnying mang po/ de bzhin 'dab lo rgyas pa'i gsom sdong chen po zhig bcas yod/ zing 'khrug skabs de dag me lha'i zhal du btab zin/ yig rnying lhag 'phros rnams lo bcu'i god chags skabs gar song cha med du gyur/ deng sang dran shes thar thor dang gna' bo'i sasung rgyun la brten nas gnas don der lan 'debs rgyu'i gnas la gyar ba'i skor gsung byung bas kho bo yang blo yid slong blong por gyur nas re zhig ci bya gtol bral du gnas/ 'on kyang pha mes kyi gsung rgyun thugs la mnga' ba'i kha che bgres gras kha shas deng sang 'tsho bzhugs yin pas kho bos khong rnam pa'i gsung rgyun nag 'gros su bkod nas 'dir kha che'i brjod gzhi mdo tsam gling rgyur chad lhag nor 'dzol ci byung gzur gnas rnam dpyod mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i klog pa po tsho thugs bzod par gyis shiglha sa ba tshos kha che rigs gnyis su dbye srol yod/gcig ni bar skor gyi kha che ste/ mang che ba bar skor nang tshong gnyer 'tsho sdod byed/ kho tsho ha lam pha yul ka shi char phyir log zin te deng sang mthong dkon pa yin/gcig shos ni wa pā gling gi kha che ste gna' bo'i grong khyer lha sa'i shar lho'i mtshams su rub sdod byed mkhan yul — 24 —
mi yin/lo rgyus la phyir mig bltas tshe sngar lha sa skyid chu ni kha che'i phyag 'tshal khang gi 'gram nas nub tu rgyugs 'gro yi yod pas chu rags kyi byang ngos su 'tsho sdod byed mkhan kha che de tshor lha sa ba tshos wa pā gling (wa pā zhes pa rgya skad kyi zur chags/ chu rags kyi don no/) kha che zhes 'bod srol yod/66kha che ’ zhes pa de bod skad nang i si lam chos —lugs la dad pa byed mkhan tshor go dgos shing / la las de ni ka shi rmir zhes pa'i sgra de bod skad du chags pa'i skad dod yin zer sgros yod/ de yang khungs lung spu tsam med pa ma yin snyam/ lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha 〈〈deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 〉〉su sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog 5kha che'i paṇi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa mnos sa zhes 'khod pa'i nang gi kha che zhes pa de yul la go dgos shing / 'dir slob dpon de nyid kha che'i yul nas gangs ljongs su zhabs bcag pa'i don bstan rna/ des na kha che zhes pa'i tha snyad de thog ma sa ming nas rim bzhin gang zag ming du 'gyur ba yin snyam mo/thog ma'i wa pā gling hud rigs khrod kyi skyes pa tsho ni kha che'i rigs rus 'khrul med yin/ kho tsho bod la slebs — 25 —
nas bod rigs skye dman tsho dang gnyen sgrig byas te rim ba'in kho tsho'i mi rabs rjes ma tsho skye 'phel byung ba red/ de min wa pā gling gi kha che dang bar skor kha che gnyis chos lugs gcig mtshungs yin pas chos khang gcig nang phyag 'tshal rgyag gi yod stabs/ kho tsho'i dbar 'o chu lta bu'i 'brel ba byung ste rim ba'in bag ma gtong len gyi goms srol chags nas de gnyis dbar gnyen 'brel tshugs ste rigs kyi myu gu 'phel ba rnams la mi tshos lha sa'i kha che zhis brjod/rtse mor tshes gsum zla ba'i dbyibs can bkod pa'i mchod rten gzugs kyi khang pa thos brtsegs can dang / g.yu lo rab tu rgyas pa'i gsom sdong / brjid chags sgam brling ldan pa'i phyag khang bcas nas lha sa'i kha che'i phyag 'tshal khang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams gyur ches cher mngon gyi 'dug phyag 'tshal khang 'di lta bu zhig bod kyi yu la gru ga'an du ha lam mthong dkon pa yin/ phyag 'tshal khang der lo rgyus ji tsam ldan min bod kyi yig tshangs nang yo da nges kyang kho bos mjal ma song / da lta mthong chos su gyur ba'i dngos rdzas la rtog zhib cig byas ma lha sa'i kha che lha sar ji tsam nas 'go tshugs ste ga'i chasas pa rjes dpag gi sgo nas lam — 26 —
tsam rtogs thub/ de ni don snying ldan pa'i bya ba 'is yin na'ang kho bo'i rtsom thung 'di'i nang lha sa'i kha che'i sngon chad dang da lta'i 'tsho ba'i skor rags tsam gleng rgyu yin/i si lam chos lugs la dad pa byed pa ni lha sa'i kha che'i mtshon rtags mngon che shos yin 'ing / chos dad kyi kun slong bye brag pa des kho tsho'i thun mong gi bsam pa'i 'tsher so grub pa yin 'dug de min kho tsho'i za lugs/ sdod lugs/ 'gro lugs/ tha na brda sprod kyi skad kyang bod rigs dang ha lam dbye ba med/i si lam chos lugs la rtsa ba'i blang bya khag lnga yod/dad ldan tshos rtsa ba'i blang bya lnga po de rang gi mig 'bras bzhin gces srung thub na chos pa rnam dag zhig tu rtsi'o/dad ldan tsho'i lta spyod gnyis ka rang rtogs kyis sdom khrims srung dgos pa las de la btsan po dbang yod byed mi rung ba kho tsho'i chos lugs nang gsal yod/ lha sa'i kha che tshos rang nyid kyi chos la dad zhin kha zhe gnyis med byed cing / kho tshos chos dang 'jig rten 'tsho ba gnyis 'o chu bsres pa lta bu'i 'brel ba dam por bzung gi yod pa de nga tshos dus rgyun mthong lus red/bsdoms rtsis ltar na lo gcig la kha che'i dus chen — 27 —
khag dgu gtong srol yod/ dus chen dgu po de dag chos lugs dang 'brel ba med pa gcig kyang med/ phyung gnas lo gsar ni dus chen rgyas shos yin/ snyung gnas sung ba'i ring nyin re lto dus gnyis te thengs dang po tho rengs chu tshod drug pa dang / thengs gnyis pa mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig par za yi yod/ nyin mor phyag 'tshal thengs lnga rgyag dgosde ni skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon thams cad kyis brtsi srung zhu dgos pa'i chos khrims red/ mtshan mo chu tshod bcu gcig yol rjes/ phyag khang nas chos dad pa yongs la gsol tshigs thengs gcig bshams kyi yod/ gsol tshigs kyi 'gro gron yongs khungs khag cig sger gyi 'al 'debs dang / de min kha che phyag khang dmangs gtso do dam u yon lhan khang nas gtong gi yod/ nye ba'i lo shas nang sger gyis gtong sgo gtong mkhan je mang du 'gro yi yod pa dang / sbyin bdag tshos tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang bya ba'i kun slong bcangs nas sbyin pa rgya cher btang ste spyi la sman pa'i bya ba bsgrubs kyi yod/ snyung gnas nyin sum cu sung ste nyin sum cu so ho gcig pa de snyung gnas lo gsar la ris/ de nyin tshang mas dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang dus ston la rol ba dang / lto gos phongs pa'i khyim tshang rnams kyang gzhan dang 'dra bar dus — 28 —
men la skyid po yong ched/ zhogs pa snga po nas mi rnams kyis dge skul zhal 'debs kyi dngul rnams dbul po'i them dud khag la bskyel bar 'gro yi yod/ chos lugs kyis dad ldan rnams la sbyin pa rgya cher gtong ba'i blang bya 'don pa dang / dad ldan tshos chos lugs kyi blang bya snyon med nan srung byed kyi yod/gor pan dus chen de yang dgod bro po zhig red/ dus chen gyi nyin der them dud tshang mas glang gog dang / lug bshas btang nas sha khag cig dbul po tshor sbyin gyi yod/lha sa'i kha ches bshas btang ba'i zog mang che ba rang gi khyim du gso tshags byas pa'i glang khog yin pas lha sa ba tshos dus chen de la glang khog dus chen zhes brjod kyi yo da/yi si lam chos lugs kyi gnas mchog me gā dang / rme sde rar mjal bar bskyod na nges par du glang khog dus chen snga bsnub tu gnas der 'byor dbos pa'i shod sgros 'duggnas mchog tu glang khog dus chen 'khel nas de ga'i nyams thag la sbyin pa rgya cher gtong thub na phan yon brgya'gyur stong 'gyur yod pa red/ kho bos sa 'o te a rab la gnas mjal du phebs myong ba'i bgres song tsho'i khrod nas shes rtogs byung bar bgrang bya sum cu'i sngon du kho tshos — 29 —
bzhon rta chibs te lha sa nas rdog thon/ lam bar la brgyab rlung brgal ngang rgya gar ka lon yug tu 'byor/ de gar bzhon rta btsong ste me 'khor nang bzhugs nas ka rli ka ta dang / sdom spel brgyud gru gzings su bzhugs nas mtha' yas rgya mtsho sgrol/ skam sar 'byor rjes slar yang rnga mong chibs te mu med bye thang brgyud de ga'i nas sa 'o te a rab la 'byor gyi yod/ skabs de dus yul gru de shin tu skyo po yin zhing / sprang po mang po yod pa dang / la las pha rol po'i sbyin pa thob ched phang pa med par rang gi rkang lag gcod pa dang / tha na rang gi mig 'bras kyang phyir phyung nas khrom gzhung thog slong mo byed kyi yod/ de dus sprang po tshor kha gang skar ma tsam gyi sbyin pa gtong dgos na'ang yin cig mngon chung dgos pa las mngon che drags na ga'an gyis 'phrog bcom byed nyen yod/ de dus gnas mjal thengs gcig zhu bar thung na zla ba bcu dang / ring na lo gcig tsam 'gor gyi yod/bgrang bya sum cu se gol tog bzhin 'das zin/ deng skabs lha sa'i kha che sa 'o te a rab la gnas mjal phebs mkhan rim bzhin je mang du 'gro yi yod/ da lo phan chad kha che them dud bcu gnyis dang mi grangs bcu bzhi gnas rṣi — 30 —
mchog mjal bar phebs zin 'ing / dus yun kyang zla ba gnyis tsam las 'gor gyi med/ gor pan dus chen skabs lcag zog bshas gtong ba dang / nyams thag rnams la sbyin pa gtong ba'i chos lugs kyi sngar srol ni sngar bzhin mi nyams par gnas yod/ 'on kyang sa 'o te a rab la 'pho 'gyur chen po phyin te rgyal khab de ni lo ba'i bcu'i gong gi nyams thag rgyal khab de min zhing / yul de'i mi rnams kyang de snga slong mor brten pa'i sprang po'i gnas las sgrol te da cha khrim tshang tshang mar mkha' rlung tsha grangs snyoms sgrigs 'phrul gas yod pa dang / phyi ru thon tshe rlangs 'khor ci dgar spyod mkhan sha stag 4gyur zin/gnas mjal zhus nas rang yul du log pa'i mi de gus bkur bste stangs bya yul hā ci'i zhes par 'gyur gyi yod/ chos lugs nang gsal hā ci'i la 'gyur ba'i mi de dam tshig sdom pa de bas nan srung dgos pa dang / nyin rerphyag 'tshal thengs lnga chad med rgyag dgos shing / rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i don du mgo bde glag tshong dang / mi bden rdzunsgrig la sogs pa'i 'jig rten phal pa'i spyod pa rnams spangs dgos/ nyo tshong byas kyang drang po drang bzhag byed dgos/ de ltar srung thub na phan yon skye bo phal pa las ldab — 31 —
don bcu don lngas che ba dang / 'gal na sdig ltung gong gsal ldab grangs bzhin che ba yod/ der brten gnas mjal la phebs thub mkhan mang che ba khyim tshang 'byor pa ldan shing / gso dgos skyong dgos bya mi dgos pa'i bgres song sha stag red/ lam bar gyi ngal dub dang lhag par arab bye thang gi tsha bas gagres song de dag gi phyi lus kyi phung por gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phrog gi yod rung / nang gi besems rgyud 'i dul nying 'jags su gyur nas tshe mjug de bag yod don ldan ngang 'da' bar byed/lha sa'i kha che tsho yul 'di'i steng 'tsho sdod byas nas rim ba'in tsho pa 'ig tu gyur ba red/ sdom ris rags tsam byas par ga'igs na da bar lha sa'i grong mir gyur zin pa'i kha che them dud 2 5 mi grangs 162 0tsam yod pa de dag mang che ba kha che'i phyag 'tshal khang nye 'khor du rub sdod byed cing / kho tsho ni las la brtson zhing / rnam rig bkra ba dang /tshogs pa'i skyid sdug gi la rgya shin tu zab pas them dud dbul po tshor nang khul nas skyob gso sprod kyi yod/ der brten lha sa'i khrom gzhung thog kha che'i sprang po gcig kyang mthong rgyu med/ lha sa'i kha che lha sa'i yul 'dir rang tshugs thub pa'i tsho pa 'ig tu 'gyur thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa — 32 —
der rdzapos bltas tshe kho tshosal si lam chos lugs la dad ba gyed pa de ba95 che'i rgyu mtshan yin pa'i khar lo tshupa thog nas rgyun 'ded rgyu yod pa'i kha che'i tshogs pa 'ig btsunasayod pa de'ang tod rgyugs gtong mi rung ba'i rgyu tshan zhig red snyam/ kha che'i tshogs pa de zi khron tshogs pa dang / yun nan tshogasapa nang bzhin dmangs khrod kyi tshogs padang mi 'dra zhing / srid gzhung gis ched mngags btsugs pa'i srid 'dzin dbang cha ldan pa'i las khungs kyi rtsa ———'dzugs dang yang mi 'dra/ kho tsho'i tshogs pa'i 'go parasred gzhung dpon rigs kyi gdan thob dang gla rdzogs med/ 'on kyang kho tshos tshogs pa'i 'go pa byas te/ chos lugs byed sgo khag dang rgyun ldan bya ba tsag tsig rnams bsgrub kyi yod la kha che nang khul gyi dmangs don rtsod snyog re zung la'ang the jus byed kyi yod/bcings 'grol ma btang gong / tshogs pa de khrang ku khru'u (rgyun las khang ) zhes bya/ de'i 'go pa thog mar kha che mang tshogs kyis bdams pa dang / 'dems thon byung ba'i mi der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi chog mchan thob dgos/rgyun las khang la spyi'i dbu 'dzin (tsung shang la'o ) gcig dang / lha sa bas 5bshad yon 7zhes 'bod pa'i (pa'o — 33 —
krang ) mi gnyis bskos te kho gnyis kyis rgyun ldan las ka thag gcod byed kyi yod/ rgyun las khang de bod sa gnas srid gzhung 4so nam las khungs 7kyis do dam byed kyi yod/de min las sne mi brgyad yod pa ste mdzod gnyer mi gnyis/dngul gnyer mi gnyis/ khang gnyer mi gnyis/ rnga gnyer mi gnyis bcas rgyun las khang de khyon mi bcu gcig las grub pa red/rgyun las khang gi las 'gan gtso bo ni kha che phyag khang gi chos lugs byed sgo khag sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / 'gro gron gtong len/ 'das po'i dur 'jug de bzhin phyag khang zhig gso dang / mkho chas gsab snon/ dog sde dur sa (gas pa shar ) bcas bdag gnyer do dam bya rgyu red/ de min rgan rgon pho hreng mo hreng 'das rjes kho tsho'i sdod khang bdag sprod phyir gtong dang rnga gnyer bas bshas btang ba'i phyug zog gi pags pa dang rnga ma so nam las khungs la khral du 'bul dgos/ kha che nang khul gyi kha rtsod 'khrug pa byung 5 rigs nyes tshabs yang bar rgyun las khang nas khrims thag gcod chog pa dang / nyes tshabs che rigs 66so nam las khungs nya la snyan zhu 'bul te thag gcod gnang rgyu sgug 55dgos /— 34 —
lha sa'i kha che'i rgyun las khang gi rtsa 'dzugs de dus ji tsam la btsugs pa dang / de'i dbu 'dzin bsko ba'ag thengs ga tshod byas yod da lta kha gsal zhig brjod thabs bral/yin yang dbu 'dzin lo gsum na thengs re brjes srol yod pa de rgan rabs tshor gsung rgyu 'dug lo rabs sum cu'i skabs rma ken khren zhes pa'i dbu 'dzin 'jon thang che ba zhig byung 'dug khong 66bshad yon 7 gnang ring hud 5 rigs kyi bu phrug tshos rgya yig dang bod yig sogs yig rtsis sbyangs nas rjes rabs rnams yig rmongs gnas las sgrol rgyu'i 'bod skul gnang ba ma zad/ lag pa dngos su sgul te dge rgan gdan drangs nas phyag khang nang du slob khang dang slob khrid yo byas sogs kyi cha rkyen skrun 'dug 'on kyang khong gi thugs 'dun bzang por rnying zhen bag khum can tshos zur za tshig mtshon mang dag byas te bya ba bzang po de lam lhong byung med tshod red/ de dang dus mtshungs su 'jon thang che la blo rig bkra ba'i kha che'i dbu 'dzin (tsung shang la'o )zhig thon 'dug khong shing 'bras ljon shing 'debs gso'i las la mkhas pas nor gling dga' tshal gling du rtsa shing 'debs gso'i phyag las gnang zhing / skabs der rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsug par rgya yig bka' khrid zhu myong yod pa'i — 35 —
shod sgros 'dug khong nor gling dga' tshal gling du phyarga las gnang ring / kha che phyag 'tshal khang nang 6 shing me tog mang po 'debs gso gnang yod pas de khul gyi ljan lden khor yug rnams rim ba'in 'gyur nas lo rabs lnga bcu par slebs dus phyag 'tshal khang gi khor yug tu ljon shing gi lo 'dab rgyas pa dang / ñtsa shing me tog bzhad de dri ngad phyogs bcur 'thul 'ing / 'dab chags kyi dbyangs snyan sgrog pa bcas yid kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i dga' tshal ji bzhin gyur yod/ deng sang yang khong gi 'debs gso mdzad pa'i ku shu'i sdong po mthong rgyu yod pas de dag ni skabs der khong gis ngal ba lhur len tshad med gnang ba'i dpang po 'khrul med red snyam/ i si lam gyi chos lugs la dad pa rtse gcig tu gnang mkhan dbu 'dzin khong mi tshe'i mtha' ▶▶ mjug tu nang bstan gyi rjes 'jug pa zhig chags nas phyag la ma ṇi phyag skor rnams te gling skor du phebs kyi yod skor thos byung / khong gi tshe mjug tu gdams ka de 'dra 'ig gnang dgos don ci yin/ khong gi thugs bzhes bzang por kha che nang khul nas skyon 'dzugs zur za byas te lam lhong mi byung bas thugs rab tu 'khrug ste ldog pa'i bya ba 'di 'dra zhig rkang btsugs nas brtsams pa e yin/ yang na zabs— 36 —
yongs rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar gting mtha' mi dpog pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis khong gi blo yid rab tu 'phrog nas tha ma'i gdams ka de 'dra zhig ma gnang mthu med byung ba yin nam kho bo'i ngos nas bshad na de ni dpog par dka' ba'i lkog 'gyur gyi don 'ig yin no/rgyun las khang gi dbu 'dzin nas las sne bar dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang ci yang med la kho tshor gla phogs skar li tsam med/ 'on kyang khong tshos rang dor ga'an gces kyi kun slong bzang po bcangs nas dmangs la phan yon tshun gyi yod/ deng sang yang phyag 'tshal khang gi dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi tshos sngar mus bzhin srol bzang rgyun 'dzin gnang ba de ni bsngags par 'os pa 'ig red/ rgyu dang dngul la brkam chags sred zhen che ba'i deng sang spyi tshogs khrod kyi skye bo'i blo la dngos don de rigs gshongs dka' ba yin no/da lo dgung lo drug cur phebs shing / las gnas rgan yol dgongs zhu zin pa'i blo mthun kra'o sbe dron ni kho bos rgyus mnga' yod pa'i kha che rgan gras shig red/ khong gis skabs gong ma'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yo na lhan khang gi ku'u rin gzhon pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes dus phyag — 37 —
khang sgo rwa'i nang 'khru khang dang / chu skol khang sogs gtsang sbra'i sgrig chas cha tshang btsugs te phyag 'tshal la phebs 5 mkhan tsho'i 'phral 'phral gyi dka' ngal sel rgyu gtso byas/zhor du phyag khang la yong 'bab phran bu yod pa bcas khong gis thugs nus yod rgu 'don gnang mdzad 'dugkhong gi 'gan bzhes lo dus gtsang rjes/ khong tshud pa'i mi grangs 2 5las grub pa'i 669 ri ti 7zhes pa'i tshogs pa zhig btsugs te zla rer rang gi yong babs nas sgor sum cu bton te 669 ri ti'i 7dge las thebs rtsar 'jog gi yod/ khong rnam pas 'gro song brgyab te brten yul med pa'i kha che pho hreng mo hreng tsho'i 'das 'jug bya ba gnyer nas spyi la phan pa'i bya ba de rigs mang po bsgrubs yod/las dgongs zhus rjes rang khyim du blo bde bag phebs ngang tshe mjug skyid po zhig bskyel rgyu de rang gzhan tshang ma'i 'dod blo red/ yin na yang khong gis rnyog dra tsha la 'gro song 'gro rgyu'i bya ba de 'dra 'ig dang du blangs dgos don ci yin/don de'i skor kho bos khong la bka' 'dri zhus pas khong gis 66tshe mjug tu dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba re zung sgrub thub na nga rang dga' po 'dug nya zhes dgyes tshor ngang gsung byung /blo mthun kra'o spe dron lta bu'i rang dor gzhan gces gnang — 38 —
mkhan mi sems rtsa 'khol po 'di 'dra kha che'i nang khong gcig pu ga la yin/ khong rnam pa'i rang dor gzhan don 'grub pa'i lta spyod bzang po'i drin las da gzod lha sa'i kha che nang khul mdza' bshes 'cham mthun dang / gcig rogs gcig phan gyi 'brel ba bzang po de 'dra zhig 'dzugs thub pa de yang kun gyis bsngags par 'os pa'i yul yin no/lo bcu grangs gong ṇa che'i phyag khang gi shar nub phyogs su kha che'i khyim tshang rkyang rkyang rub sdod byed kyi yod/de dus kho tsho'i sdod khang gi bkod pa yang ga'an dang mi 'dra bar thog gcigi ma sha stag yin zhing / thems dud rer sgo rwa re dang / sgo rwa'i nang tsi shing gi sdong po/ sgo rwa'i phyi la tshal zhing rwa ba bcas yod/ tshal 'ing rwa ba'i mtha' ba'i g.yag gi rwa co brtsegs pa'i rtsig pa las grub pa red/ 'dzam gling thog g.yag gi rwa co'i tsig pa brtsegs mkhan ang dang po de blo rig bkra ba'i lha sa'i kha che red ces bshad na sgro bkur spu tsam ma mchis/ rwa co'i tsig pa 'gro gron chung la ( skabs der rwa co gang sar bsgrugs chog ) sra ba'i ( bzha' tshan bzod thub pa ) khyad chos ldan khar thun mong ma yin pa'i bzo sgrun gyi nyams 'gyur ldan yod/ dus deng sang rwa co'i rig khu/ btam gyi cod sgros tsam las mig lam du rig rgyu med/— 39 —
phal cher bzo las ches cher 'phel rgyas 'gro bka deng gi dus 'dir rwa cos tshal zhing chung chung zhig srung nas bsdad na glang po cher mgrin bzang gi khal bkal ba'i tshul du song bar snyam ste kho pa tsho rang rang gi 'jim thang ston par phyin pa 'dra/ de ltar yin yang kho tsho'i lus phung gis sra zhing gamkhregs pa'i rig pa brtsegs te mi yul 'dir zub thabs med pa'i shul rjes bzhag pa de mi tsho'i dran shes kyi me long ngos nas nam yang 'phyis thabs bral ba red/de snga'i sdod khang gcig thog ma de tsho mig lam du chamdzes po med kyang / sgo rwa'i kho ra khor yug tu shing 'bras sdong po'i ga yu lo sngo thing thing dang / me tog sna tshogs khra chil ler ba'ad pa'i tshul 'dir bsams tshe de ni dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas shig yin pa'i tshor snang zab mo ster thub/ 'on kyang deng gi dus 'dir da dag ming gi lhag mar gyur te de'i tshab tu spros pa rgyas pa'i bod khang thog brtsegs can pa ṭa'i ri mo ba'in gsar du thon pa dang / wa pā gling khul du 'byor pa phyug pa'i khams pa tshong pa'i sdod khang thon zhing srang lam phra mo sngar bas gu dog cing kyag kyog mang bar gyur 'dug da ni kha che'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis kyang sngar dang mi 'dra bar 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba mthong — 40 —
rgyu 'duglha sa'i kha che tsho tshal dang shing 'bras 'debs gso bya rgyur nang byan chud pa zhig red/ kho tshos nang sa'i tshal rigs sa mtho'i steng 'dren nas 'debs gso byas te lha sa'i tshal khrom gra rgyas phun sum tshogs su btang yod/ de snga lha sa'i 66'ong stod 'ing kha'i 7tshal khrom thog bshams pa'i kha che'i tshal rigs la gzhan gyis 'gran par mi nus shing /lhag don kho tshos bsnyal ba'i hru'u yan tshal gyi sbo ba 'di dus da lta'ang dran pa tsam gyis 'gram chu shor dgos pa 'ig red/skabs dere lha sa'i tshal rigs 'debs las dang tshong 5 gnyer byed mkhan khrod du rus ming krang can gyi kha che zhig yod pa khong gi tshal zhing gi ga'i khyon dang / tshal gyi 'debs las/ tshong gnyer byed thabs la sogs lha sa'i grong du tshal zhing 'debs las byed mkhan mang po'i nang de pho tshogs pa'i dbus su bya khrung khrung bzhugs pa ltar dge mtshan gyi phyogs mang po mngon rgyu yod/lha sa'i kha ches tshal zhing 'debs las byed pa phud/ kho tshos gnyer ba'i sha khrom la yang lo rgyus thung min tsam 'ig gling rgyu yod/spyi lo 1959lo'i ring 'khrug zhod 'jag ma btang — 41 —
gong bar skor gyi shar ngos su sha'i khrom rā 'ig yod pa der lha sa ba tshos che sha khrom 'og 7 ces 'bod/ der sha 'tshong mkhan them dud drug cu tsam yod pa tshang ma kha che bud med sha stag red/ kho tshos gri gug rnon po zhig lag tu 'khyer te ma lag bde po'i ngang sha dang / rus pa/ tshil lu rnams khag so sor gtub bsel byed pa dang / skabs der rgya ma'i thog 'degs 'jal byed pa'i goms gshis med kyang kho tshos sha nyo mkhan gyi slo ma'i nang blugs pa'i sha de tsho tig kha re ṣkagnyis las he dbag 'dzol gyi med/ sha khrom 'og gi tshag sha de dag wa pā gling lho ngos su gnas pa'i bshas rwa 66chu mig sgang ji nas dbor yong gi yod/ skabs der lha sa grong khyer nang bshas rwa 'ga' shas yod rung che chu mig sgang 7bshas rwa phal cher ga'i rgya che shos yin/ bshas rwa de'i rgya khron rmi grub bzhi ma 140 0lhag tsam yod cing / thang chen po de'i dbus su khrom pa gcig yod/ bshas bya'i sems can rkang lag bsdams te ske la gri ma btsugs gong lus phung be'u yi che chung la 'gran nus pa'i khyi mthug po bcu grangs zhig der 'khor nas mig rtsa dmar chil chil 'jigs che ba zhig — gdangs te dmar zas sgug nas sdod/ bshas pa'i ngag nas gang 'don pa mi shes/ chu to krab kub lan 'gan byas rjes — 42 —
bshas gri rno po bton nas sems can gyi mid par btsugs tsam byed pa las de min las ka yod tshad bshas g.yo ga gis byed kyi 'dug ha lam zas thun gcig bza' ba'i yun tsam las ma 'gor bar sems can gson po gcig gi pags pa cha tshang bshus rin pa dang / nang khrol yod tshad phyi la bton/sha bzhi ling phral te slel por blugs nas dbor 'gro yi 'dug kho tsho'i lag rtsal dngos 'brel byang chub pa cig red 'dug bshas btang zin pa'i sha bzhi ling de tsho lam seng khrom rwar ma dbor par nyin mtshan gcig khyim du nyar tshags byas/ phyi nyin zhogs pa gzhi nas sha khrom 'og gi khrom stegs thog mthong rgyu yod/ de ni phal cher bod rigs tshos nyin sha bza' ba'i goms gshis med pa der kho tshos bstun pa 'dra/ bshas las tshar ma thag khrag la rngam pa'i khyi mthug po de tsho mchongs yong ste sa la 'dzags pa'i khrag ldag gin 'dug chu mig sgang ji gi khyi ni khrom gzhung gzhan gyi khyi las stobs che ba dang / ngar che ba yod pa de yang rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig la thug pa min nam snyam/lo re'i bod zla bzhi pa ni ston pa shākya thub pa sku bltams pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus khyad par can zhig yin pas de'i skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha — 43 —
sa yongs la bshas gtong mi chog pa'i bka' rgya bkrams kyi yod/ sa ga zla ba'i dus kyi na chu mig sgang ji la dus rgyun gyi zang ring rnam pa de 'dra mthong rgyu mi 'dug der 'khor ba'i khyi rnams kyang thar thor re gnyis las mthong rgyu med par/gnas de re 'ig mya ngam thang lta bur gyur gyi 'dug ljags smin ’ gyi ming thob pa'i them dud gnyis yod pa de yang kha che yin/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis kha che khyim tshang de gnyis la che ljags smin gyi thob thang sprad nas ched mngags rgyal ba rim byon gyi gsol khram tshong 'bul zhu ba'i dmigs bsal dbang cha sprad pa de'ang rgyu mtshan med pa min/ kha che sha khrom bton mkhan tshos rgyun ldan 6 lug mgo bkal te khyi sha btsong ba'i ji tshul min spyod pa spel mkhan med cing / kho tsho'i sha gtsang ba/ nyo tshong drang bzhag yod pas mi tsho'i yid ton rung bar gyur ba red/ sa ga zla ba'i ring lha sa yongs la sha khrom bton mkhan 8 ljags smin 7mi tshang de gnyis rang las med/lo rgyus thog kha ches bshas btang ba'i sems can gyi pags pa dang rnga ma sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'brel yod do dam las khungs su khral la 'bul dgos/ las don 'di kha che'i rgyun las khang nas don gnyer bya rgyu dang / 'ib phra rnga — 44 —
gnyer gnyis pos 'gan khur dgos/ kha che'i rgyun las khang gis sa gnas srid gzhung la pags pa dang rnga ma'i khral rtsa chag yong rgyu'i zhu ba lan mang 'bul mthar sa gnas srid gzhung nas pags khral rtsa chag gtong rgyu dang / rnga ma sngar bzhin 'bul dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas te kho tshos spyi lo 1959lo bar rnga khral chag med phul gyi yod/lha sa'i kha che'i khrod 'tsho rten dras 'tshem lag rtsal yin pa mang po yod/ kho tshos 'cham chas dang / lha chas/ thang ga lta bu'i bzo rtsal che rigs mi shes rung / spyir btang gi gos thung stod thung 'tshems rgyur lag rtsal byang chub pa yod/lo rabs sum cu pa nas bzung / lha sa'i grong nang gi sde dpon mi drag dang / 'byor ldan tshong pa'i bu phrug tsho'i khrod du bod chas bzhag ste phyi gling pa'i kyon chas la dar so chen po byed kyi yod/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang / khrom rwa'i dgos mkhos kha che 'tshems bzo bar tshong rgyugs 'phel ba'i go skabs bzang po bskrun te kha che'i 'tshems khang nang phyi gling ba'i gyon chas 'tshems rgyu skyel mkhan dang dod can mang po mthong rgyu yod/ 'tshems bu ba i si kha zhes pa'i kha che 'tshem las mkhas pa de'i ming yang dus de nas rim bzhin lha sar khyab pa yin no/— 45 —
grong khyer lha sar che rgya mi'i gro zhib 9 dar ba'i skor shod dgos na de'ang kha che'i gro khang ma gleng ka med red/ lha sa'i kha che'i nang gro khang gnyer mkhan them dud 'ga' shas yod/ wa pā gling kha che bgres song zhig gi gsung tshul ltar na gro 'thag gi lag rtsal de kha ches thog ma nang sa nas 'dren yong tshod 'dug kho tshos mi rabs kha shas lag len byas nas rim bzhin byang chub par gyur te skabs der lha sa'i nang gro 'thag lag rtsal ha lam kha che yag shos red/ de snga bod la gro zhib med pa ma yin/ yin na'i bod pa'i gro zhib kyis kha ches 'thag pa'i zu rgya mi'i gro zhib 7kyi spus tshad la slebs mi thub na gro thag lag rtsal mchog tu gyur pa'i mtshan snyan de kho tshor ma gsol ci la gsol/ skabs de'i lha sar tas zhim la skyisogs kyi rgyu cha gro zhib spus legs rgya gar rgya nag nas dbor ba phran bu phud/ de byings bod pa'i gro zhib sha stag yin/ bod pa'i gro zhib nang gro lpags bsres te gro zhib ring po red/de'i dus su kha ches gro khang btsugs/ gla mi bskong ste gro zhib spus legs mang po khrom rwar bton pas bod pa'i gro zhib rim ba'in lha sa'i khrom rwar mthong rgyu med par gyur/ skabs der kha che'i gro khang 'ga' shas yod pa'i nang che gro khang —bzhi'i ’ thon 'bor dang spus tshad la 'gran phod mkhan — 46 —
med pas gro 'thag khyim tshang 'di'i mtshan snyan dus da lta'ang thos rgyu 'dug5rgya mi'i gro zhib 7'bor chen thon pa des lha sa'i tas zhim gyi bzo las la skul 'ded chen po thebs pa red/lhag par lha sa'i kha ches bzos pa'i tas zhim ni bro ba che la cas kha legs po yod pas tshang mas dga' po byed kyi yod/sde dpon mi drag dang / 'byor ldan khyim tshang tshos dbyar kha sdo skyid gtong ba'i dus la gling kha'i zhal tog ched mngags kha che'i tas zhim tshong khang la mngags kyi yod/ lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga' shas 'das zin pa'i da cha'i dus su gro 'ib tshang ma 'phrul 'thag yin pas de snga'i kha che'i gro khang nas thon pa'i 5rgya mi'i gro zhib 5de'ang lo rgyus 'bri ba'i rgyu cha tsam du zad do/de snga lha sa'i grong nang du za khang dang / ja khang mang po yod/ kha che'i za khang zas sne 'dzoms shing / bro ba che ba/zhabs zhu'i rnam 'gyur legs pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan yod pas kho tsho'i kha gtad gcog thub mkhan mang po med/kha che'i za khang khongs su dus da lta yang ming 'bod rgyu yod pa de lug tshang za khang redaka skabs der lug tshang za khang nang spyi tshogs thog drag 'an bar gsum gyi mi tshang mar rang — 47 —
gi 'khos 'byor la dpag pa'i za rigs sna tshogs bza' rgyu yod/ che sar cha bzhag na de snga go min tang bod sdod don gcod khru'u yi gsol ston thog bsham pa'i tshal rigs sna tshogs lug tshang za khang nas bzo yi yod/ de ba'in lo 5gcig dus gcig gi cho 'phrul smon lam chen po tshogs nas byams pa gdan 'dren zhu ba'i mdzad sgo grub rjes mdzad sgo'i las bya dpon rigs tshos lug tshang za khang nang 'char can kha lag thengs gcig za yi yod/ dus rgyun du za khang nang ja btung lto zas byed mkhan mi rdzogs rgyu med/ lug tshang za khang gi ming de yang rim bzhin lha sa grong khyer yongs su rgya grags bod grags su gyur ba yin no/de bzhin lha sa ba tsho kha che'i ja khang nang ja 'thung bar 'gro rgyur dga' po yod/ ja khang de tsho'i nang ja zhim po yod pa ma zad/ kha che'i gtam bshad de las snyan pa yod/ lha sa'i kha che tsho ja khang nang ja 'thung zhing / kha brdar glod rgyur dga' po red/ kho tsho'i smra ba la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos chen po ldan yod/ smra mkhan gyi kha dang / lag pa/ rnam 'gyur bcas zung du sbrel zhing / brjod bya snyan la bstan bshig tsha ba/ nyan po'i blo la bag chags zab po 'jog gi yod pas ja khang nang ro bcud ldan pa'i ja 'thung gin —— 48 —
gtam de' radra rna bar thos dus srid pa'i longs spyod kyi dpal la rol ba'i snang ba dbang med du ster gyi 'dugja gang nang skabs re 5kye rim 7'gran bsdur tshugase kyi red/ de tshor ltad mo bltas na deng sang e ṭa rla'i rim pa dang po'i rkang rtsed spo lo'i 'gran sdur gyi ltad mo yang cho chen po mthong mi yongaka skabs der lha sa'i nang skad grags che ba'i 4kye rim 7mkhas pa de tsho mang po ba ja khang nang nas 'tshar longs byung ba sha stag red/lha sa grong khyer nang gi mi de tsho ha cang bag yangs po red/ ston kha'i dus su rgan gzhon tshang ma khang pa'i yang thog steng langs nas gnam la bya 'phur glod pa'i goms gshes yod/ ston gyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing / ston rlung bsil po ldang ba na mkha' dbyings su tshon mdog sna tshogs las grugepa'i bya 'phur g.yas lding g.yon ldeng byed pa'i tshul 'di dwangs gsal chu yi dzing bu ru gser mig 'khyug 'gros byas pa dang kun nas mtshungs/bya 'phur de tsho mthong dus kho bo'i yid la kha che bgres po hram tshad kyi mtshan lhang nger dran mi'adug khong gi zhal ras mjal ba'i bskal ba bdag la thob med kyang / bdag chung ngu'i dus nas khong gi mtshan bzang po rna bar thos myong / skabs de'i lha sa'i grong — 49 —
nang khong gis bzos pa'i bya 'phur la skad grags chen po yod/ der brten rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pas khong la dmigs bsal tham ga gnang yod zer sgros 'dug de — bden rdzun ci yin kho bos bgres song tshor bka' 'dri zhus pa yin/ khong rnam pas che sba pa hram tshad bzos pa'i bya 7 'phur gyi steng la rgya yig brkos pa'i tham ga dmar po zhig btab yod pa de bden pa red/ yin na yang de rgyal ba rin po ches khong la gnang yod med tan tan zhu yag mi 'dug ’ ces lan gnang byung / khong la rgyal ba rin po ches tan tan tham ga gnang yod dam med kho bos rtsad chod thabs bral 'ag yin na'i khong gi bzos pa'i bya 'phur de lha sa'i grong nang 'gran zla bral ba yin pa kho bos skyar bzlos mi dgos par tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ bgres song hram tshad kyis tshobzos pa'i bya 'phur la skad grags yod pa ma zad/ bgres song khong 'tsho zhugs skabs dgod bro ba'i satam snyan po gsung rgyu yod pa de tsho khong dang 'brel 'dris yod pa'i bgres song tsho'i thugs la nges shag red na khong gi mtshar gtam de tsho thos myong mkhan tshos yig thog tu bkod de nga tshos mjal rgyu yong bar kho bos yid ches byed kyi yod/bgres song 'a mal ri yang bgres song hram tshad 'dra — 50 —
blo'i dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal mkhas pa zhig red/ lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i nang gzim shag che khag gi thugs spro'i gsol tshags dang / dbyar skyid skabs su sgra snyan dkrol gtong 7mkhas pa 'a mal ri zhes bya ba'i mi de lha sa ba tshos ngo mi shes mkhan med/ skabs de'i nang ma'i rol cha skyed sdug nang 'a mal ri'i sgra snyan dkrol gtong gi chu tshad la tshang mas gdeng 'jog mtho po bzhag gi yod bzo 'dug nga tshos bgres song khong gis lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i nang dkrol gtong gnang ba'i skad par phan tse gcig gsan rgyu byung na khong gis dkrol ba'i sgra snyan rol dbyangs la snyan cha ldan zhing /babs chags pa/ nying ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan yod pa de tshor thub/ de'i dus kyi sgra snyan dkrol gtong mkhas pa mang po'i khrod du da bar mtshan snyan bags chags 'jog thub mkhan ha lam bgres song 'a mal ri tsam min nam snyam/gcig byas na kho bo thos rgya chung bas gtam de don la gnas pa min shas che/bgres song 'a mal ri'i rjes rabs pa/ khong gi gnyen nye rma had pi ni ho ching dang / og len rol cha la mkhas pa'i sgyu rtsal mkhas pa zhig red/ lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i lo mjug tu lha sa'i grong nang rma had pi yis og len rol cha dkrol — 51 —
gtong gnang ste khong gi mtshan snyan yongs su grags par gyur/ lo rabs bdun cu par slebs dus las don gyi 'brel bas rkyen byas te sgyu rtsal mkhas pa khong gi 'al dngos su mjal thub pa byung / skabs der khong thugs spro'i gsol 5 tshigs kyi zang ring nang rol cha dkrol nas phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs gnang mkhan mi 'khrug po de 'dra ma yin par khong bza' tshang bu phrug dang mnyam du rdzong zhig la bzhugs nas dal zhing nying ba'i khyim tshang chung chung gi 'tsho bar rol mkhan na so rgas pa'i mi nying po zhig red 'dug kho bos khong gi rgya chen po rang med pa'i bzhugs khang du 'dzul ma thag rig ldebs su ho'o ching rol cha 'ig bkal yod pa de mthong nas rol dbyangs dum bu gcig dkrol gtong gnang rgyu'i re skul zhus pa la khong gis spro ba chen pos zhal bzhes gnang byung / khong gis ris ldebs nas rol cha blangs te che mtshan mo bzang 7 zhes pa'i gzhas gdangs dkrol byung bas nyan bzhin nyan ba'in bdag gi rna bar khong gis 'das zin pa'i mi tshe'i skyid sdug brjod kyi yod pa'i tshor snang byung / phar bltas tsa na khong gi sgam zhing brling ba'i rnam 'gyur de las bdag la sems gting gi snying gtam brjod kyi yod pa'i mthong snang byung / shin tu snyan pa'i rol— 52 —
dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug de dag bdag gi rna ba'i bu gar lhung dus pha rol pos bdag la yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sgrungarkogtam zhig gsung gi med dam snyam pa byung / rol cha mkhas pa rma had pi yis lha mo dbyangs can mas tam bu ra dkrol pa lta bu'i snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i rol dbyangs kyis bdag gi yid re zhig myos pa ltar gyur to/ a tsi/ sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis phyug pa'i skye bo de 'chi bdag zhags pas bkug snga drags song / khong gis rol dbyangs ni rang gi yid kyi rten pa gcig pur stsa zhing / des khong gi sku tshe'i 'go nas mjug bar 'grogs te mi tshe'i shul lam ring po de 'grims pa red/sgyu rtsal dang lha sa'i kha che'i dbar la las smon mtshams sbyor zab mos 'brel ba lta bu lo rabs brgyad cu nas dgu bcu'i bar bod rigs kyi glu gzhas dang / mdzes ris/ 'jim bzo bcas kyi sgyu rtsal nang grub 'bras thon pa'i kha che shes ldan mi sna 'ga' shas thon yod/klu dbyangs kyi slob grwa chen mo 'grims myong ba'i lha sa'i kha che rma a lu zhes pa khong ni da lta lo na dar sgang yin zhing / bod kyi klu dbyangs bya ga'ag don du rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'bul phod pa'i shes ldan mi sna zhig red/ khong slob gra chen mo'i sgo thon ma thag rba rlabs 'khrug pa lta bu'i — 53 —
'tsho ba dngos nang 'jug rgyu'i 'dun pa drag pos bskul te ngal dub khyad bsad byas nas ha lam bod sa mtho'i zhing 'brog khul du 'gro ma myong ba med/ mang tshogs ni rig rtsal las don pa'i pha ma yin zhing / 'tsho ba dngos ni rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi rig stobs 'phel ba'i 'tsho bcud 'dzad mtha' med pa'i 'byung rtsa yin pa khong gis gsal rtogs byung ste phun sum tshogs pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod glu dbyangs bsdu rub byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog deng dus klu dbyangs kyi gsar rtsom dang gzhung lugs gsar du gtod pa la grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa thob nas da cha khong gis brtsams pa'i gzhas gdangs la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos chen po ldan khar khong gis bod rigs kyi klu dbyangs la zhib 'jug byas pa'i nang ga'an las lhag pa'i lta ba gsal ston gyis ched rtsom spel ba de tshor rig lam dpyad gros kyi rin thang chen po ldan yod pas krung go'i glu dbyangs mkhas pa tsho'i thugs snang byung yod la gdeng 'jog mtho po gnang ba red/khong dang dus mnyam pa'i gzhas gdangs gsar rtsom gyi bya bar mkhas pa'i kha che so ma rna ni blo rig bkra la gsar rtsom thad skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i skye bo dar ma zhig — 54 —
red/ khong gis nye lam gsar rtsom gnang ba'i gzhas ga55 gdangs 'ga' zhig rang re'i ljongs kyi bod rigs mang tshogs tshos thugs mnyes po gnang gi yod pa ma zad/ ljongs phyi'i bod rigs tsho dang / phyi rgyal la bzhugs pa'i bod rigs spun zla tshos kyang thugs ha cang dgyes po gnang gi yod/de snga 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb khang gi rtsom sgrig phyag las gnang myong ba'i shes yon can bgres song sku zhabs rma sha'o slan gyi khyim tshang de dngos gnas sgyu rtsal mkhas pa 'dzoms pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu rtsi chog bgres song khong la phru gu bu ba'i yod pa nas bu gsum gyis sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs te khong tshos brtsams pa'i ri mo'i brtsams chos dang / 'jim bzo'i brtsam chos de tsho ljongs phyi nang gi tshags par dus deb khag dang / sgyu rtsal 'grems ston khang mang po'i nang mjal rgyu yod/ kho tshor gzengs bstod bya dga' yang mang po thob yod kyang 'dir yig tshogs la 'jigs te ma bris so/ bgres song khong gis de snga bod kyi ge sar sgrung deb legs sgrig zhib 'jug gi phyag las gnang myong bas khong pha bu mi rabs gnyis pos bod kyi rig rtsal bya gzhag 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur mdzad rjes zub — 55 —
thabs med pa bzhag gnang ba rad/lha sa'i kha che'i khrod du bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang /rkang rtsed spo lo/ chu rkyal kyi rim rol tshed la sogs pa'i byed sgo'i nang phul byung mi sna mang dag cig thon yod pa de tsho lha sa ba tsho'i thugs la gsal po red/bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i dus rabs gsar pa'i sgo mo phye zin pas de'i khrod du lha sa grong khyer gyi bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas su gyur ba'i lha sa'i kha che'i nang gsar thon bya ba dang / gsar thon mi sna mang po char shul myu gu rgyas pa ltar thon dang thon mus yin te de dag tshang ma kho bos rtogs ga la nus/ 'dir kho bo'i gzugs 'dzin dbang pos gang — mthong ba dang / sgra 'dzin dbang pos gang thos pa rnams sug bris bgyis pa la khron pa'i gting gi sbal pas gnam gyi rgya khyon gleng ba'i tshul du ma song ga la srid/lha sa'i shes rig gong 'phel 'gro ba'i lo rgyus shig gling dgos na lha sa'i kha che'i gnas tshul ma gleng ka med red snyam/ de gnyis po spyi dang bye brag lus dang yan lag sdong po dang yal ga'i tshul du 'khod nas sa mtho'i grong khyer 'di'i thog gnas yod stabs lha ldan grong khyer gyi rig gnasaskyo'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi gzhal med khang bzang zhig — 56 —
bskrun phyir cha shas su gtogs pa'i rig gnas 'di rigs la snang chung hod rgyugs ma yin par mang mang chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad med mjal rgyu'i spyan 'dren tsam du kho bos 'dir na shod rgyun ’ gyi tshul du song ba'i yig thung 'di nyid spel nas lhag bsam dkar pos mkhyen ldan klog pa po'i spyan sngar gsol ba lags so/
bod kyi deng rabs rig rtsal gyi gzhung lugs zhib dpyod tshogs 'dun zhugs pa'i myong tshon phran bu/na ning zla 12 pa'i tshes 21nas tshes 27bar grong khyer lha sa nyi 'od mgron khang du rigs gzhung tshan pa lngas mnyam gnyer byas te rig rtsal gyi gzhung lugs 'ib dpyod gros tshogs skong tshogs gnang song / kho bo ni rig rtsal gyi gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gnang mkhan mkhas pa tsho dang dpung pa mnyam gshibs kyis rig gzhung bgro gleng byed pa'i shes bya yon tan dman na yang khong rnam pa'i gsung gi bdud stsa longs spyod byed pa'i 'dun pa che rang drags te thabs shes res skor byas mthar gros tshogs la zhugs rgyu'i go skabs bzang po zhig thob byung /tshogs 'du gtso skyong gnang mkhan gyis tshogs phebs mkhas pa tsho tshogs chung gsum la bgos gnang 'dug de yang rtsom rig la tshogs chung gnyis ste bod skad tshogs chung dang rgya skad tshogs chung / sgyu rtsal tshogs chung gcig bcas — 58 —
red 'dug kho bos bod skad tshogs chung khongs su zhugs te tshogs mi tsho'i bgro gleng la blo gcig sgrim gyis nyan 'jog byas pa yin/ tshogs chung 'di'i nang khyon bsdoms tshogs mi bcu yod pa'i nang bud med gcig 'dug phar bltas na khong rnam pa dgung lo sum cu'i g.yas g.yon du phebs pa'i dar ma sha stag yin pas thog mar kho bo'i blo la rig gzhung 'ib 'jug dpyad gling gi ngos nas bshad na mi de tsho da lta phru gu rang red/ 'jig rten gtam dper byis pa nya rgyas na'i rkang mar khrag khong tsho'i 'al las mkhas pa'i gsung zhig grags rgyu cang med do snyam ste gral mjug tu 〈〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsam sgrung de kha phye ste klog gin bsdad pa yin/ skabs der bod kyi snyan gzhung me long gleng ga'ir bzung ste bgro gleng gnang gi 'dug de yang brgya bshad stong bshad byas zin pa'i gtam rnying pa zhig red/ de ring skyar du gling ba ni lha khang rnying par gnas bshad gsar pa brgyab pa'i tshul las ma 'das pas des kho bo'i yid kyi dang ba 'dren mi thub snyam te mu mthud brtsams sgrung klog gin bsdad pa yin/ mtshams 'dir gros tshogs khang gi zur du bzhugs pa'i blo mthun sku sha skam po zhig gis gsung skad sbom la skad shugs che zhing / spyan gnyis hrig hrig tu — 59 —
gzigs te bka' mol 'di 'dra zhig gsungs song / 46nga tsho bod kyi rtsom rig la gzhung lugs med pa ma yin/ mi lo 5 bdun brgya lhag tsam 'das zin pa'i snyan gzhung me long ma de bod kyi rtsom gzhung min na gang yin/ ngas bltas na 5 gzhung de nas gsung pa rnams la deng skabs kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la bstun tekha gsab byas na de ni rang cag bod rang gi rtsom gzhung phul du byung ba zhig la 'gyur rgyu dang /dper na snyan gzhung me long ma las lus rgyan skyon sel la sogs gzhung lugs thad kyi gal che'i gnad don gsungs zin pa rnams go don rgya cher bkral rgyu dang / de'i thog srog la sogs pa'i gnad don kha skong / de min gzhung me long mar shar lho'i rtsom nyams gzhung pa de shā1 gzhir bcas kyis bod kyi rtsom rig dngos la bstun te a bod khams gsum gyi rtsom nyams/ yang na ser mo ba dang / skya mi'i rtsom nyams/yang na rtsom pa po 'di dang de'i rtsom nyams la sogs dbye zhib byas te sa bcad 'di kha skong byed thub na gzhung me long ma gra rgyas gtong ba ma yin nam/ nya bka' mol mang po mi 'dug kyang de ni rtsom rig gzhung lugs zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i thad rin thang che ba'i lta ba gsar pa 'ig red/ de snga kho bos snyan gzhung me long ma de tshigs bcad kyi rtsom lus la sbyangs — 60 —
pa byed mkhan tsho'i gzhung lis rang la tsis te des deng skabs kyi ga'i rgya che ba'i rtsom rig la khrid ston gyi nus pazhig thon thub kyi med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de ring khong gi bka' mol de thos dus ya mtshan ha cang chen po byung ste brtsams sgrung gi deb de phar ma bzhag ka med byung / de nas khong gi kha gtad du bzhugs pa'i blo mthun 'ig gis 66bka' mol de ha cang yag po 'dug nga tsho'i khrod du mi mi nyung ba zhig gis bod kyi rtsom rig la gzhung lugs med pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te phyi dar gyi rtsom gzhung khag cig thad kur rgya yig nas bsgyur te bod kyi rtsom gzhung la brtse rgyu'i kunaslong 'chang gi yod/ ngas bltas na gcig nas bsgyur pa po de tsho'i yig sgyur chu tshad mtho po med pas gzhung lugs thog ched bkol tshig brda rnams skad gnyis thod pa gtugs nas bsgyur stabs bod yig thog go brda ma 'phrod pa'i skyon lhag gi 'dug dper na gzugs snang bsam gzhigs zhes pa'i tshig 'di rgya yig ma shes pa'i bod rigs shig gis tshig zin nas tha snyad 'di'i don rtogs ha cang khag po red/ 'di dang de ba'in gyi gnad don mang po lhag pas phyi dar rtsom gzhung bsgyur ma rnams bod kyi rtsom pa po'i khrod du rtsa ba tshugs khag po red/ lhag par du phyi dar gyi rtsom — 61 —
gzhung zhig gis rang mi rigs kyi gsar rtsom lag len 'a khrid ston byed snyam pa'i kun slong bcangs pa de ni mda'i gtsang chus phu'i than skyon sel ba la re ba dang gcig mtshungs yin no/ der brten phyi dar rtsom gzhung dpyad ga'ir byas nas rang rigs su yod mus kyi rtsom gzhung me long ma 'di nyid yod pa dar spel/ med pa bskyar snon bya rgyu de ni rtsom gzhung 'ib 'jug bya rgyu'i lam bu 'ba' zhig red snyam nya zhes gsung pa dang 'dir bzhugs tshos rang rang gi blo sgo yangs par phye ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan te bgro gleng 'khrug po gnang song / la las 66rang re'i sngon byon mkhas pa mang pos mi rabs nas mi rabs rgyud de snyan 'grel po ti du ma brtsams yod pa de ga rang bod kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang du 'grub rgyu'i bya ba byas zin/ ji la las 66snyan ngag me long ma 'phel med sor bzhag byas na mthar nyams chags rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu nyag cig red/ der brten nga tshos deng skabs bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel phyogs la bstun te gzhung 'dir snon 'phri spor gcig bya rgyu de gal 'gangs ha cang chen po red/ dper na snyan ngag gi srog gi skor 'di mkhas dbang zur mkhar ba dang / rgyal ba lnga pa chen pos zur tsam gsungs yo da kyang / de la deng skabs — 62 —
rtsom rig la bstun te mtshan nyid dang mtshan ga'i ba'ag med stabs srog med smra ba po'i gnod byed gtong yul du 'gyur te dus da lta'ang thag chod med/ don du rtsom rig gi ngos nas bshad na srog gi gnad don de thog mar thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don 'ig red/ byas tsang de gtan 'khel byas te gzhung me long ma'i nang kha gsab byas na slob dpon dan ṭi yang phal cher thugs mnyes po yong gi red/gang lags she na slob dpon nyid kyis / de ni da lta'ang rnam rtog ste/ de dag ma lus sus 'chad nus zhes gzhungs pas so la las che las 'gan 'di ni gzi brjid che la dka' tshegs ldan pa 'ig yin/ thog mar gzhung me long mar gsar bcos byas na ston pa'i dbu la byis pa'i lag rtsed red snyam pa'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan gyi bkag rgya las 'ol dgos/ de nas bod mi rigs la rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs med snyam ste phyi dar gzhung lugs bsgyur te go brda 'phrod min la ma ltos par bod kyi rtsom gzhung la rtsis mkhan de tsho dgag dgos/lta ba mtha' gnyis su ma lhang par gzhung me long mar gsar bcos 'thus tshang sis bod kyi rtsom gzhung du 'gyur rgyu'i lta ba dbu ma pa 'ig brtan por btsugs nas dang thog rtsom rig gi rig pa khag dpyis phyin pa rtogs dgos/ de yang — 63 —
snyan gzhung me long ma mthil phyin rtogs dgos pa smos med thog rgya yig thog nas rgya rigs dang phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig bzhung lugs rgyus lon pa/ deng skabs kyi rig pa gsar pa ste sgeg dpyod rig par thos pa gang tsam yod pa/ bod mi rigs kyi snga phyi bar gsum gyi rtsom rig brtsam bya lta myong yod pa/ bod mi rigs kyi skad yig la rgyus mnga' gting zab yod pa/ da dung bod rgya dbyin la sogs pa'i skad yig ▶▶gsum ba'i tsam gyi shes yon ldan pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mang po zhig tshogs te bod kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs shig bzos rna da gzod kun gyi khas blangs thub pa'i bod kyi rtsom gzhung zhig 'grub rgyu yin pa gor mi chag der brten las 'gan 'di lta bu zhig 'phral 'phral bsgrub da71ri bas mig sngar sngon 'gro'i bya ba khag cig sgrub nas gzhal yas khang de bskrun rgyur rgyu cha gsog 'jog byas na 'os pa 'dug snyam/dper na la las brtsam bya'i brjod don snying por dmigs te srog skor gleng ba/ la las rtsom gzhung la bkol ba'i ched spyod tha snyad de dag phyi nas blangs te de la mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi 'jog rgyu/ la las snyan gzhung me long ma'i shar lho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom nyams gtod tshul la dpyagga'i byas te bod kyi rtsom rig nang rtsom nyams so sor dpyad — 64 —
paṃ bya rgyu/ la las snyan gzhung me long ma'i skyon sel la gzhir bcas te rtsom rig brtsam bya'i skyon yon brjod pa'i skor gzhung lugs thad sa bcad kha skong rgyu/ la las snyan gzhung me long ma'i sgra don gab tshig gi rgyan la sogs par dbye zhib byas te gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs 'dod pa'i blo gsar tshor go bde la spyod go chod pa'i lam khrid 'khar ba zhig sprod rgyu/ de dang de la sogs pa'i bya ba de dag re re bzhin bsgrubs nas thigs pa bsags te nam zhig rgya mtsho grub pa'i dus su bod kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs shig thon rgyu'i cha rkyen bslun zin pa yin/ rmang gzhi de 'dra zhig gi steng du bskrun pa'i rtsom gzhung gi bkod legs khang bzang 'di nyid sus mthong na yang yid kyi dbang po me 'phrog pa ci la srid ces gsungs so/khong rnam pas bgro gling gnang ba'i gtam de dag gis kho bo'i yid kyi brtan pa yongs su 'phrog ste dus yun ji tsam 'das pa'ang mi tshor bar dgong zas kyi dus la bcar zin/ dgong zas tshar ma thag ngas blo mthun bkra shis lags btsal nas bod yig tshogs chung de'i tshogs mi tsho'i gnas tshul 'ib phra bka' 'dri zhus pa yin/ khong gis gsung par gzhigs na tshogs chung de'i tshogs mi'i nang dgung lo che — 65 —
shos bzhi bcu zhe drug dang chung shos sum bcu tham pa red'dug khong tsho'i khrod du rtsom rig zhib 'jug gi ched las pagcig phud/ de byings la la slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig dge rgan dang / la la yig sgyur gnang mkhan/ la la rtsom sgrig gnang mkhan/ la la rtsom rig dang 'brel ba ye nas med pa'i gzhung gi phyag las gnang mkhan yin 'dug pas khong gi ngo spyod gnang ba de dag rna bar thos dus kho bo'i yid la kun rtog gi ri mo ci yang shar byung a tsi/ khong rnam pas las zhor du bod kyi rtsom rig la do khur che bzhes dang mno bsam zab mo de 'dra gnang dgos don ci yin/ khong rnam pa slobgrwa chen mo gang dang gang la phebs myong yod dam/ re 'ig lkog gyur du song ba'i gnas tshul de dag shes 'dod chen po'dug kyang phran nyid /yong rnam pa dang 'brel 'dris medpa'i stabs kyis stong char lus song / 'on kyang de ring gros bsdur bya rgyu'i nyin ma dang po de yin pas rjes sor gyi nyin shas nang bka' dri zhus te ri mo'i lam du 'god rgyu yin/mtshan mo glog sgron 'og 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉zhes pa'i dus deb de blangs te nyin mo lta 'phror lus pa'i rtsom yig la bltas pa yin/ 'on kyang kho bo'i sems de srab dang bral ba'i rta rgod cig dang 'dra bar tshur 'gugs ga — 66 —
thabs med par gyur song / nyin mor khong tshos bgro gleng gnang ba'i skabs kyi bzhin gyi rnam 'gyur dang / lus kyi 'gul tshul la sogs kho bo'i 'dren byed yul du khra lham mer 'khor ba dang / khong tsho'i gsung sgra rna lam du thos te yid la 'char sgo'i rba rlabs 'phyur nas 'jag thabs mi 'dugye ma/ rang cag kha ba ri pa'i rtsom rig bya ga'ag la dngos 'brel phugs re'i skya rengs shig shar byung / a ho/ phugs bsam ldan pa'i mi de tshos ngo ma rang gi rngul chu la brten nas bod kyi rtsom rig gi dga' tshal zhig bskrun gyi 'dugkhong tsho'i gzugs brnyan brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas kyi shel gyi me long ngos las rig rgyu mi 'dug khong tsho'i byas rjes tshags par dang dus deb thog nas mthong rgyu mi 'dus yin na yang khong tshos kyag kyog gi skya lam ring mo'i thog gom stabs brtan po spos te mdun du bskyod pa'i rdog sgra 'ig kho bos thos byung / rdog sgra des mi sems la ngam ngam shugs kyis skul slong gi lcag tshan zhig brabs byung / rdog sgra 'di 'ded nas yid gzab kyis btsal 'tshol 'ig byas na kyag gyog gi rkang lam phra mo'i steng du zub tu mi rung ba'i 'bas rjes zhig tan tan rnyed rgyu yod kyi red/spyilo1989lo'istonakharanya'odamagronakhangadubrisapa'o— 67 —
zho ston gyi rnam pa/dbu rtse'i gtsug tor gser gyi cod pan bcings/phyogs bzhir sgrib byang bsangs kyi dri 'im 'thul/mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i thub pa'i sku/dad ldan skye bo'i snang ngor mngon par gsal/sor bcu'i 'dab ma snying khar rab 'khod cing /rtse gcig dad pa'i kun slong legs 'chang ste/dge ba'i bsngo smon ngag gi lam las drangs/skya b.ri cig kun mkhyen mchog la gsol ba 'debs/rnam dkar dad pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba nyid/kho lag yangs pa'i lus kyi nyams su bstar/lugs bzang lha mo'i 'khrab ston galas phud 'di/'gro ba'i rnam 'dren mchog la mchod gyur cig— 68 —
gro ba'in zla ba'i 'dzum zhal mngon ma thagphun tshogs nor gling dga' skyid chu gter rgyas/'khri shing tshar du dngar ba'i yal 'dab rtser/'dab chags dbyangs snyan gre 'gyur glu len zhing /mar gad gcal du bkrams pa'i ni'u gsing gzhir/ma snyigs me tog tshoms bu rab bkod pa/dwangs gsal chu yi rdzing bu'i me long du/ga'al yas pho brang sgeg tshul rnam par gsal/nyin byed snang ba'i zer brgyas sa gzhi brgyan/lha mo'i rnga thub dkrol ba'i sgra snyan pos/gzigs mo ba rnams brel gyis 'dir 'du bas/khams yangs nor bu'i gling yang dog por gyur/rab mdzes rigs lnga'i bu mo'i chas spras shing /'gyur khug rnam thar mgrin pa'i tshal las drangs/ldem 'khyug gar gyi nyams 'gyur legs bstan pa /ganda ra sba dag gnas 'dir byon min nam/— 69 —
rngon pa'i yang rtsal mdun na nags gseb spre'u yang re zhig ri mo'i tshul du gnas/rgya lu'i rnam thar gdangs kyis gdong lnga'i khrir bzhugs mi dbang gzi byin mog por gyur/rigs lnga'i bu mo'i mdzes pas ri bong can yang ga skyengs te chu 'dzin gseb tu yib/rmad byung sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis gzigs mo ba rnams re zhig bza' btung sred pa bral/glu gar la sogs 'khrab ston sgyu ma'i rtsal//shā ༵ bhee snazlo kṣiṃ tram̐ (33 (( zlo/shā 〉spra hūm̐ 'a/ gro/gru 'dzin gnyis pa 'i do zlar 'os pa su/bho ṭa'i sgyu rtsal snam bzang las grub pa'i/lha mo'i 'khrab ston rmad byung lu ba 'di/skal bzang zho ston gzhon nu'i sku lus la/sgron te kun gyi yid dbang cig car 'phrog— 70 —
lo phyug 'bras bzang mtshon pa'i snying po'i bcud/rab dkar zho yi ston mo legs bshams te/skal bzang dus babs mi 'gyur nam gnas pa'i/smon tshig lhag bsam dar dkar mgul du gsol/
bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig skor gleng ba/dngapo/ dengadus(rnamapa/spyi lo 1978 lor tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes chab srid bsam blo'i lam phyogs thad zing rbacos yo bsungs byas pa dang / rang rgyal bya gzhag gi gtso gnad dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun thad 'jog dgos pa'i lam phyogs gtan la phab ste 'thab phyogs khag la dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad pa lta bu'i rnam pa bzang po zhig thon yod pa red/dus mtshungs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal thad la'ang dar rgyas kyi rnam pa bzang po zhig thon 'ing / lhag don spyi lo 1979lor krung go rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las don pa'i 'thus mi tshogs — 72 —
chen skabs ba'i pa tshogs te tshogs 'du'i thog ting sha'o bang gis mdzub ston rang ba'in ldan pa'i gsung bshad gnang ba des rtsom rig sgyu rtsal thad yun ring gnas pa'i gnad don 'ga' shas bsed bkrol gtsang ma byung ste kha phyogs gsal po byung ba dang / dus rabs gsar pa'i nang rtsom pa po tsho'i las 'gan yang gsal ston gnang yod/tshogs 'du grol rjes rgyal yongs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi bya ga'ag thog grub 'bras mngon gsal dod po thob yod/bod sa khul du cha ba'ag na spyi lo 1980 lorahu ya'o pang dang / dban ṣā rnam gnyis bod la phebs te las don gzigs zhib gnang rjes spung dbyang yig cha ang drug pa bton pa'i nang mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang /rig gnas las dzi'i thog zhib cing phra ba'i rtsa che'i bka' slob gnang nas bod kyi 'dzugs skrun bya ga'ag la lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i skul 'ded chen po thebs pa dang / sgos su bod kyi rtsom rig thad la yang skul ma thebs nas mi rigs rang nyid kyi yi ge bed spyad nas thad dzir brtsam bya 'grems spel bya yul 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉zhes pa'i dus deb lda gsar du thon pa red/ de ni bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes rtsom rig thad ched gnyer gyi bya ba dang po yin — 73 —
zhing / bod kyi lo rgyus thog bag chags zab po 'jog pa'i bya ba rlabs chen po zhig yin la tang gis mi rigs sa khul du'dzin pa'i mi rigs srid jus don thog 'khyol ba'i dpang rtags bcas yin gshis de yis 'byung 'gyur bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang gsar gtod byas te 'dzam gling yang thon gyi rig gnas gras su slebs rgyur don snying ldan yod cing / bod rigs mi dmangs kyi bsam dngos gnyis kyi dpal yon dar rgyur nus pa nges ldan 'ig thon rgyur gdon mi za/de bzhin mtsho sngon dang / kun lho/ lha sa/ ze khron bcas su rtsom rig ched dmigs kyi bzhugs mol tshogs 5'du skong tshogs byas te tshogs 'du'i thog mi rigs kyi rtsom rig dar rgyas gtong rgyu'i gnad don skor tshogs zhugs 'thus mi tshos rtsa che'i dgongs 'char mang po gnang ba dang /bod yig gis gtso bo byas pa'i gsar thon phul byung brtsam byar gzengs bstod bya dga' sprod rgyu'i byed sgo spel yod mig mthong lag 'dzin gyi bya ba de dag spel ba rgyud mi rigs kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag dar rgyas song bzhin yod la mi rigs kyi rtsom pa po'i dpung khag cig 'tshar long yong bzhin yod/bod rigs sa khul la da lta rtsom rig ched gnyer gyi dus deb — 74 —
gag bcu tsam yod pa'i thog rtsom 'bor chen zhig bton te bod rigs kyi rgya che'i klog pa po tsho'i spyan sngar ltar ba dang /spun zla'i mi rigs kyi klog pa po tshor bod rigs kyi rig gnas ngo sprod byas yod/nga tsho bod ljongs sa khul du cha bzhag na bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol btang nas spyi lo 1980 lo'i bar lo ngo sum cu'i nang thon pa'i gsar rtsom brtsam bya'i bsdoms 'bor dang / spyi lo 1980 lo tshun chad lo lnga'i nang thon pa'i gsar rtsom brtsam bya'i bsdoms 'bor gnyis bsdur thabs bral ba red/ spyi lo 1980 lo'i gong du bod ljongs sa khul du bod yig rtsom yig ched du dmigs nas gnyer ba'i dus deb mthong rgyu med/ don dngos kyi gnas tshul de tsho nas tang krung dbyang gis mi rigs sa khul du 'dzin pa'i mi rigs srid jus yang dag pa yin pa ma zad/ lag len dngos brgyud de thad grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa thob yod pa de'ang dngos ra gsal po 'phrod pa red/bod rigs kyi rtsom rig bya gzhag la mig snga'i rnam pa bzang po de 'dra zhig thon pa ni lo rgyus thog gi skabs ga 'dra zhig dang bsdur na'ang bsdur thabs bral ba red ces kha mtshon bcad de bshad chog— 75 —
bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog dus rabs bcu bdun bco brgyad kyi mtshams su phul byung brtsam bya mang po thon te dar rgyas kyi rnam pa zhig thon yod pa red de skabs de dus kyi brtsam bya mang che ba'i brjod bya'i nang don rnams 'khor ba snying po med pa'i chos la skul ba'i snying don ston pa dang /rjod byed tshig sbyor rnams mngon rjod dang / brda rnying gis bcings stabs mi 'bor spyi'i bsdom grangs kyi brgya cha dgu bcu lon pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis lta thabs bral zhing brtsam bya mang che ba'i rjod gzhi yangs po min par lha yul dang / rgyal khang gi 'tsho ba brjod par zad pas de ni rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang kha bral ba red/ skabs de dus bod kyi yig mkhan nang rtsom rig gi brtsam bya mi nyung ba 'ig thon yo da bzo 'dug ste rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi bar chad 'phrad de rgya khyab ngang khyab gdal song med stabs rtsom rig thad me tog brgya phyag rnam par ba'ad pa'i dus babs 5 bzang po 'ig thon thub med/ des na bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog rnam pa bzang po 'ig thon pa'i dus skabs ni da lta rang yin no/gnyisapa/ bodakyirtsomarig lorgyus thogasnyanagazhungame yongam dar — 76 —
rgya dang dararjes gyi gnasatshularags bshad/1 rtanagazhungamelongasal dganangagibodarmya marigmi'i rigs byung ba dang chabs cig sgyu rtsal thon pa yin zhing /cirang re bod ljongs sa khul la yang de ltar yin no/'on kyang mig sngar nga tsho'i mig lam du bod kyi gdod ma'i dus su sgyu rtsal ci 'dra zhig yin min dpyad ga'i'i yig rigs mthong dka' bas smra ba'i skabs dang bral lo/ yin na'ang de yis skabs de dus sgyu rtsal med ces shod mi thub/bod btsan po'i dus su sgyu rtsal gyi rnam grangs khag yod pa ni da lta'i yig rigs khag nas gsal po mthong thub/lhag par srong btsan sgam po'i dus su thon mis bod yig gsar bzo gnang ba nas bod kyi dmangs khrod kyi ngag rtsom mang dag cig yig rtsom la 'gyur nas phyi mir 'dren byed kyi longs su spyod rgyu'i go skabs bzang po thob pa dang / brtsam bya de dag la sgyu rtsal gyi nyams ches cher ldan yod pa de'ang gsal po mthon thub/ dpe mtshon tsam du drangs na chab chab ni chab chab/ yar chab ni pha rol na/ myi'i bu ni myi'i bu ste/ lha yi ni sras po bzhugs/ rje bden gyis ri bkol du dga'/ sga bden gyis ni bstad du dga'/ zhes bya ba'i shags tshig de — 77 —
da lta'i yig srol la 'gyur nas bsed bkrol zhus na chu bo chu bo'i phar 'gram na/ yar chab gtsang po'i phar 'gram na/ mi ni mi yi bu yin yang / don la lha yi sras po bzhugs/ bdenpa'i rgyal pos g.yog tu bkol na dga'/ bden pa'i sga ni rgyab tu bstad na dga' zhes brjod do/gnam ri srong btsan skabs su bod rje'i gnyen tshan du gtogs pa'i rgyal phran zing po rje bya bas legs pa nyes par bcug nyes pa legs par bcug stabs yul mi rnams zhe log mi drag dba' dbyi tshab ces pa de yang ngo log zing po rjes myang tseng ku dang dba' dbyi tshab gnyis ngo dga' sprel lad kyi rtsal gyis phyug pa'i gnyan 'dzi zung gi bran du bkol/ dba' dbyi tshab kyi phru gu dba' to re dang gshen khri gzhir gnyis 'thab nas gshen gyis dba' bsad pa la zing po rjes bden pa dpang por bzhag ste thag gcod ma byas par brten dba' dbyi tshab yi ma rangs/ de na nyin zhig myang tsing ku dang dba' dbyi tshab gnyis khyim du log pa'i lam bar du myang tsong kus gong du brjod rin pa'i shags tshig de 'gyed pa red/ shags de nas myang rtsang ku yang zing po rje la zhe log pa'i bsam pa gsal por bstan pa yin no/— 78 —
