spus dag mang po spel 'dug pas de tsho 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb la gzigs na gsal po mkhyen thub/ 9 lo 1984lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb ang 55 gnyis pa'i thog 〈〈skyed ma 〉〉 (rtsom pa po grags pa 'byung gnas ) zhes pa'i rang mos snyan ngag cig spel 'dug pa de bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig khrod du rtsom srol gsar pa thon pa'i thog ma yin/ dus de nas bzung rtsom srol gsar pa'i rba rlabs shig 'phyur te lo bcu'i ring 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉zhes pa'i dus deb kyis gtsos bod yig gi tshags par dang dus deb khag la rang mos snyan ngag 'bor chen thon yod/ de tshor deng dus kyi gzhon nu klog pa po tshos 5thugs mnyes po gnang gi 'dug rang mos snyang ngag gi rtsom pa po tshos mi tshe dang spyi tshogs la thad gar kha phyogs nas rang gi sems pa'i bye brag gson rjen mtshon yod stabs rtsom gyi rnam pas rtsom gyi nang don la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dgos pa nan po bstan yod pa dang / kho tsho'i brtsams chos la dus rabs kyi rnam pa rang shugs su thon thub kyi yod/ de 'dra yin yang rang mos snyan ngag ni bsres lhad mi zhugs pa'i rin chen sa le sbram zhig ma yin pa'i stabs kyis da lta'i cha la yang de'i thad rtsod gleng mi nyung ba zhig yod mus yin — 228 —
yang de tsho rtsod pa rgyag ri yod pa yin snyam/ lo bcu'i ring dus deb tshags par thog spel zin pa'i rang camos snyan rtsom khrod du nangari don dang rtsom rtsal gnyis thad nas sus tshad mtho po yod pa'i brtsam bya mi nyung ba zhig thon yod/ de tsho'i khrod du blo mthun don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈lang tsho'i 'bab chu 〉〉zhes pa'i rang mos snyan rtsom de ni rtsom pa pos dung sems zab mo bcangs te tshig rtsa nan po bkol nas bod rigs kyi gzhon nu'i mi rabs des 'bad pa hur bskyed kyis dus rabs kyi khur po dang du blangs rgyur skul ma btang ba'i nang don mtshon par byas yod/ brtsams chos hril po nas rtsom pa pos me ltar dbal tsha ba'i nang sems kyi kun slong de nyid phyi rang mos snyan ngag gi rnam pa'i thog nas bkod pa yin tsang nang don dang rnam pa gnyis shin tu mthun zhing / spyod byed tshig brda dang / brjod bya snga rjes mthun sbyor byed stangs la blta dus snyan rtsom de la thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom nyams zhig mthong rgyu 'dug blo mthun o rgyan rdo rjes brtsams pa'i 〈〈yid gdung mchi ma'i mchod pa 〉〉zhes pa'i rang mos snyan rtsom de la blta dus khyad chos gzhan zhig mthong rgyu 'dug snyan rtsom des 'jig rten steng du skyed mas bu phrug la 'chang ba'i dngas gtsang lhad med kyi — 229 —
la rgya zhig mtshon par byas yod/ de yang rtsom pa pos snyan rtsom thog 'tsho ba shin tu zhib tshags pa'i sgo nas bkod yod cing / spyod byed tshig brda rnams sgam brling ldan la har po med kyang bcos min gyi la rgya 'ig tshig 'bru'i gseng nas legs par mtshon yod stabs rtsom de bklags rjes yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chab kyis yid kyi sgrib pa dag par byas pa lta bu'i myong tshor yong gi 'dug deng skabs snyan ngag gyer 'don gyi byed sgo'i nang gzhon skyes tshos snyan rtsom de gnyis gyer 'dod byed mang shos red 'dug deng dus kyi rang mos snyan rtsom khrod du snyan ngag mkhan po do rje tshe ring gi brtsams chos la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig mthong rgyu yod/khong gi snyan rtsom las snyan ngag mkhan po'i yid kyi snang 7'char de nyid phyi la ston phyir ri mo'i lam du bkod pa'i yi ge de ni brda sprod mtshams sbyor byed po zhig la 6 ba las snyan rtsom gyis gtso bo sems dang sems sbrel ba dang sems dang sems nye bar bya rgyu'i nus pa thon pa'i 'dod 'dun de 'dra zhig ston gyi yod/ de la yang deng dus gzhon nu tshos yid mos chen po byed pa yin 'dugbrtsams sgrung dang / snyang ngag phud/ rig rtsom brtsams chos la dpyad brjod spel ba de yang deng dus bod kyi rtsom — 230 —
rig gi gal che'i grub cha yin pas de la 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb kyis thog ma nyid nas dam 'dzin byas 'dug zhu lo 1980lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb dang po'i thog blo mthun li'i cwa cun gyis rgya yig nas bris shing / blo mthun bstan 'dzin gyis bod yig tu phab 'gyur byas pa'i dpyad rtsom 〈〈spro snang chen pos mi rigs mthun sgril la bstod pa'i glu dbyangs bya sprel gtam rgyud la dpyad pa 〉〉zhes pa de spel yod/ de rjes spyi lo 1981lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb ang dang po'i thog blo mthun wang yo'o yis rgya yig nas bris shing / blo mthun tshe rdor gyis bod yig tu phab 'gyur byas pa'i dpyad rtsom 〈〈sa skya legs bshad la dpyad pa 〉〉zhes pa de spel ba red/bsgyur yig dpyad rtsom de gnyis 〈〈bod gyi rtsom rig sgyu be rtsal 〉〉thog spel dgos pa'i dmigs yul ni rig rtsal ma brtsam byar dpyad gleng gtong ba'i bya ba de la skul 'ded yong ba'i ched du yin pa gsal po yin 'dug de rjes mu mthud sgyur yig dpyad rtsom gling ge sar la dpyad pa dang /mi dbang rtogs rjod la dpyad pa'i rtsom yig spel yod/1983lor bod yig rang nas bris pa'i deng dus rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi rtsom yig ang dang po de thon yod pa de'i — 231 —
dpyad bya rtsom pa po lhag pa phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung thung ngu 〈〈char shul gyi nags tshal 〉〉zhes pa de yin zhing / dpyod pa po blo mthun skal bzang ye shes yin/phran gyi lta tshul la dpyad rtsom de ni dpyod pa pos rgya yig thog nas bris pa'i rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig thad kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs mang po gzigs pa de dag la brten nas bod yig gi rigs rtsom brtsams chos la dpyad pa byas pa zhig yin 'dug pas dpyad brjod gnang stangs dang / rig pa'i gzhi bcol sa/ sgrub byed drangs stangs/dpyad rtsom gyi gting zab tshad la sogs gang sa ci thad nas sngar gyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod las legs pa 'dug snyam/dpyad rtsom de spel ba'i rjes su 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb thog bod yig thog nas bris pa'i dpyad rtsom 'ga' shas mthong rgyu 'dug pa de tsho phal che ba sngar gyi srol rgyun rig rtsom brtsams chos la dpyad brjod byas pa yin pa las deng dus kyi rig rtsal brtsams chos la dpyad pa gtong ba 'ig red mi 'dug de min deng dus rig rtsal brtsams chos la dpyad brjod byas pa'i dpyad rtsom re gnyis mjal rgyu 'dug ste de tsho phal che ba ni klog pa pos rtsom yig bltas pa'i rjes kyi myong tshor brjod pa lta spu las rgyu mtshan dang ldan — 232 —
pa'i sgo nas dpyad bya'i rtsom yig gi legs nyes gsal ston byas pa zhig min stabs de tshos dpyad brjod kyi mdzub khrid nus pa dang skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon dka' ba yin/ deng dus kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas gong 'phel gtong ba la rig rtsom brtsams chos legs nyes dbye 'byed gsal ba'i dpyad brjod med na ga la rung / mig snga'i gnas tshul la bltas na dpyad brjod kyi goms stabs de rig rtsal gsar rtsom goms stabs kyi rjes su mgyogs nas myur du snyegs thub pa'i rnam pa zhig thon rgyu de kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnas su slobs 'dug gnad don de thag gcod byed pa la thog mar nga tshos mig snga'i rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi rnam par dbye zhib byed dgos/ mig snga'i rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi rnam pa de rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi bya ba'i rjes su lus yod pa de kun gyi mkhyen gsal lags/ gnad don de 'dra zhig lhag dgos don gang yin zhe na de la rgyu mtshan mang po 'ig yod nges kyang / phran gyi lta tshul la bod yig gi deng dus rtsom rig nang rtsom rin thad kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig mjal rgyu med pa de ni rgyu mtshan gal chen zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ nye ba'i lo shas nang gsar rtsom thad kyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya la sogs pa rig rtsom gzhung — 233 —
lugs dang 'brel ba'i rtsom yig 'ga' shas mjal rgyu 'dug ste de tsho gcig nas grangs 'bor nyung ba dang gnyis nas dpe deb de rigs thad kur rgya yig nas phab 'gyur byas pa yin gshis/ sgyur pa po de nyid rtsom rig ched gnyer phyag las gnang mkhan min pa yin nam/ yang na yig sgyur chu tshad kyis ma 'dang ba yin gang ltar dpe deb de rigs la lta dus spyod byed ming tshig mkhregs shing go dka' ba/ yang na ma yig gi don dang mi mthun pa'am don log pa la sogs pa'i gnas tshul ji snyed cig thon pas de tshos deng dus rig rtsom dpyad brjod bya bar mdzub khrid thub pa'i tshad ldan rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi nus pa thon khag po byed kyi 'dug de ni rgyu mtshan gtso bo yin pa dang / de min rgyu mtshan gcig la bod kyi sngar gyi rgyun srol rtsom rig nang 〈〈me long mar 〉〉dpyad brjod spel ste 〈〈me long ma'i〉〉'grel pa dang mtha' dpyad mdzad pa mjal rgyu yod pa las/ rig rtsom brtsams chos la dpyad brjod spel ba'i goms gshis shig chags med pa ltar du snang / gang lags she na bod kyi snyan grags che ba'i rig rtsal brtsams chos 〈〈gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉〉dang 〈〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉〉〈〈mi la ras pa'i gsung mgur 〉〉〈〈tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur — 234 —
glu 〉〉de bzhin lha mo'i gzhung chen brgyad la sogs pa de tshor skabs de'i yig mkhan tshos dbye zhib dpyad brjod gnang ba'i dpyad rtsom ha lam mjal rgyu med par de nas lo ngo sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam 'das pa'i rjes kyi deng dus kyi dpyad brjod mkhan tshos dpyad brjod rtsom yig spel ba'i rnam pa de 'dra zhig mthong rgyu yod/ 〈〈me long ma 〉〉bod la 'gyur nas lo ngo drug brgya lhag tsam 'das pa'i ring / bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa tshos bod kyi skad yig la bstun te 〈〈me long mar 〉〉dag bcos kha skong ji snyed cig gnang ste mthar rgya gzhung de nyid bod mis brtsams pa lta bu'i mdzad rjes bla na med pa ba'ag yod/ de ni bod kyi sngon byon mkhas dbang tshos bod kyi rig rtsom gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thad 'ib 'jug gnang ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin pa smos ci/ 'on kyang gong 'phel 'gro ba'in pa'i bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi bya ga'ag ngos nas bltas na sngon byon mkhas dbang tshos begzhung 〈〈me long mar 〉〉zhib dpyad gnang ba de dag gzhung rtsa ba rang las kha gyes thub meng la lhag par bod rang gi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi bya ba dngos dang mthun pa'i gzhung gisar pa zhig grub thub med pa'i rkyen gyis da cha'i dus su gzhung 〈〈me long mas 〉〉bod kyi deng dus rig rtsal gsar — 235 —
rtsom la mdzub khrid byed dka' ba'i gnas su gyar yod/ de yang deng dus kyi mi rang gis ma 'jon/ kha dkri sngon byon mkhas dbang tshor gzhag pa de 'dra ma yin par phran gyi brjod bya'i snying po ni sngar gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de sngar gyi lag len dngos la phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig yin tshe des sngar gyi lag len dngos la mdzub khrid kyi nus pa yod pa las rjes su 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i lag len dngos dang mthun pa'i gzhung lugs shig rjes su bskrun dgos kyi yod stabs da lta'i cha la da lta'i rigs rtsal gsar rtsom gyi bya ba dngos la phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i rtsom rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig med par stong cha'i tshul du lus yod pa de 'dra'i don 'ig bstan pa yin/ dper na/ gzhung 〈〈me long ma'i 〉〉le'u thog mar rgya gar shar pa lho pa'i rtsom gshis bshad yod pa de rgya gar gyi rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi snang tshul la phyogs bsdoms byas te bshad pa zhig las des bod kyi rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi snang tshul la mi khyab/ der brten de la gzhigs nas bod kyi rig rtsal gsar rtsom la yul gru so po'am/ rtsom pa po so po'i rtsom gshis la dbye zhib kyis rgya gar shar pa lho pa lta bu'i rtsom gshis yod nges pas bod kyi rtsom gshis de 'dra zhig red ces dbye zhib gnang — 236 —
ba'i dpyad gling zhig sngar gyi gzhung 〈〈me long mar 〉〉'grel ba bskyon pa'i dpe cha mang po'i nang ha lam mjal rgyu mi 'dug de bzhin dper na gzhung 〈〈me long ma'i 〉〉le'u 7 gsum par skyon sel brjod yod pa de ni rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi sgo mo legs po zhig 'byed pa yin rung / phyis kyi mkhas dbang tshos sa bon bzang po de 'dra ba zhig la brten nas bod kyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod gzhung lugs kyi sdong po lo 'dab rgyas pa'i dpyad gling 'ig kyang sngar gyi gzhung 'grel mang po'i nang mjal rgyu mi 'dug bod kyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi bya ba de nyid lo rgyus thog nas rmang ga'i de 'dra zhig yin dus da lta'i cha la 'an po yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen de la bsam ga'igs ma byed ka med red/ 'on kyang deng dus kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dbyar mtsho rgyas pa lta bu'i rnam pa de 'dra zhig la lta dus ring min rig rtsom dpyad brjod la skul 'ded shugs che thebs nas 'bras bu bzang po zhig thon rgyu yin pa la yid ches brtan po yod/ de min rgyu mtshan chung tshags re gnyis 'dug pa 'dir drangs na deng gi dus su bod yig thog nas dpyad brjod rtsom yig dngos su bris pa'i skabs su dpyad brjod rtsom yig la skabs 'phral mkho ba'i rig rtsom rigs pa'i gzhung — 237 —
lugs kyi bod yig gi tha snyad rang grub min stabs rtsom 'bri mkhan gyis dpyad rtsom 'bri gin 'bri gin ches spyod tha snyad mang po zhig phab 'gyur byed dgos kyi yod/ de ltar phab 'gyur byas pa'i tha snyad de dag go don brda gsal po 'ig 'phrod pa yong thabs bral bas klog pa pos gzigs dus don rtogs dka' ba/ yang na go ba log sgrub la sogs pa'i gnas tshul thon nges yin/ des rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi bya ba yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro rgyur tshad bkag shugs che: thebs mus yin pa phyag las de don gnyer gnang mkhan tshor myong tshor zab mo yod/ gong du gling ba de tsho deng dus bod kyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod de nyid zhan cha'i gnas su gyar dgos pa'i lo rgyus dang deng dus kyi rgyu rkyen re gnyis tsam zhig drangs ba yin/ de nas nga tshos mthong gsal la deng dus bod kyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod bya ba yar rgyas gtong dgos na rmang gzhi'i las ka 'bor chen zhig byed dgos pa de yin/ rmang gzhi'i las ta'i gras su rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig rtsom skor gyi tshad ldan rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dpe deb 'bor chen zhig bod yig la phab 'gyur bya rgyu de gal 'gangs shin tu che/ de dag bod yig la phab 'gyur byas pa'i rgyud rim nang rig rtsom skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung — 238 —
lugs kyi ched spyod tha snyad rim bzhin phun sum tshogs su 'gro ba dang / rma gzhi de'i thog rim pas dbye zhib mtha' dpyad byas te mthar ched spyod tha snyad de dag gtan la 'bebs thub/ des rig rtsom dpyad brjod kyi las kur phan nus chen po thon thub cing / de'i shugs la rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig rtsal gyi bsam blo gsar pa dang / rig rtsal gyi lta ba gsar pa nang 'dren byas te bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gsar rtsom de nyid 'dzam gling gi rjes su snyegs rgyur phan nus rlabs chen thon thub/ rmang gzhi'i las ku'i khongs su da dung bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig dang / rgyun srol rtsom rig la sgo kun nas zhib 'jug byas te 'dzam gling mi rigs mang por 'phrad dang 'phrad mus yin pa'i gnad don zhig ste rgyun 'dzin dang dar rgyas gnyis dbar gyi 'brel ba thag gcod yang dag yong rgyu de yin pas nga tshos kyang gnad don de thag gcod legs po zhig yong rgyur brtson len byed dgos/ de ni rig rtsom dpyad brjod yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro rgyur g.yol thabs med pa'i gnad don zhig yin/ rmang gzhi'i las na'i khongs su da dung rig rtsom dpyad brjod mkhan tsho'i bsam blo'i 'khyer stangs la 'gyur ba btang ste rig rtsom dpyad brjod las ba'i gal che'i rang bzhin dang /— 239 —
tshan rig gi rang bzhin/ dgos nges kyi rang bzhin bcas la mthong chen gyis rig rtsal gsar rtsom brtsams chos gsar pa zhig thon ma thag de la legs nyes dpyad brjod kyi dpyad rtsom spel te rtsom pa por tshur snang lan cha 'phral du byung na gsar rtsom la skul 'ded chen po thebs pa dang / rig rtsal byed sgo 'khrug po zhig yong thub/ rtsom pa pos brtsams chos spel nas rgya mtsho rdo g.yug lta bu'i da lta'i rnam pa de lta bur mgyogs nas myur du 'gyur ldog gtong thub pa'i dgongs pa tshang mas bzhes dgos pa yin snyam/ gong du zhus pa de tsho tshang ma kho bos deng dus bod kyi rig rtsom dpyad brjod bya ga'ag la bcol ba'i re 'dun yin/ 'dun pa de tsho mngon du 'gyur ba la rig rtsal gtso gnyer tshan pa'i dbu khrid tshos gnad don de la mthong chen gnang dgos la nga tsho rang nyid kyis kyang 'bad brtsod lhod med byed dgos kyi yod/deng dus bod kyi rtsom rig khrod du lhug rtsom zhes pa'i rtsom srol de brtsams sgrung dang / snyan ngag gi rtsom srol nang bzhin dar khyab chen po phyin med pa'i stabs kyis lhug rtsom gyi rtsom yig mang po ha las med la tshad ldan gyi rtsom yig rnyed dka' bas 'dir gleng bar mi bya/〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb dang / 〈〈lho kha'i — 240 —
rtsom rig 〉〉dus deb / 〈〈srung char〉〉dus deb la sogs pa'i bod yig dus deb thog rtsom rig gi brtsams chos bsgyur ma mi nyung ba zhig mthong rgyu yod pa'i rnam pa de snang 'jog chen po byed 'os pa zhig 'dug bsdoms rtsis ltar na 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb gnyer 'go tshugs pa nas spyi lo 1994lo'i dus deb gsum pa bar khyon bsdoms deb ▶▶ grangs 83bston zin pa'i nang rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul byung brtsams sgrung thung gras sgyur ma 53dang / phul byung snyan ngag brtsams chos sgyur ma 7dpyad rtsom bsgyur ma 5lhug rtsom sgyur ma 16bcas spel 'dug da dung sgyur rtsom ched sgrig dus deb gcig (spyi lo 1992lo'i deb ang 4) bton 'dug pa de tsho ni 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb kyis bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig yig sgyur bya gzhag la legs skyes bzang po zhig phul ba red/ mtsho sngon zhing chen nas bton pa'i 〈〈srung char 〉〉dus deb thog bsgyur rtsom ched 'god sa bcad bzos nas lo tsā ba gsum gyis snyan ngag brtsams chos gcig bsgyur te sgyur yig gsum ka sa bcad de'i thog dus gcig la bkod nas klog pa po'i spyan sngar 'dren pa'i gnang stangs de tsho las khong rnam pas rtsom rig yig bsgyur bya bar mthong chen gnang ba'i kun slong bzang po mtshon pa — 241 —
yin pas nga tshos rjes su yi rangs zhu rgyu yin/ bod lho kha sa khul nang bton pa'i 〈〈lho kha'i rtsom rig〉〉dus deb thog rgyal khab phyi nang gi phulabyung rtsom yig mang po bod yig la phab sgyur gnang ste bkod pa de tsho'ang klog pa po'i dga' bsu chen po thob rgyu yin par sems/ rtsom rig ched 'god dus deb kyi ngos nas bshad na dus deb thog rtsom yig gshongs tshad chen po min na yang dus deb rtsom sgrig khang gi las bya tshos bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig yig bsgyur bya ga'ag dar rgyal gong spel gtong rgyur rang nus gang yod 'don spel gnang dang gnang mus yin pa la bsngags brjod byed 'os pa yin/ des bod kyi dpe bskrun ched las tshan pas bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig yig bsgyur bya gzhag yar rgyas gong srel gtong rgyur dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang rgyur 5tshoskul ma rang shugs su thebs rgyu yin pa red/dus rabs bcu dgu'i mtshams su yo rob khul nas thon pa'i sun 'byin dngos mtshon ring lugs kyi phul byung brtsams chos khag cig bod yig tu phab bsgyur byas te skyi〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb thog spel yod pa des 'dzam gling rtsom stegs thog gi grags can rtsom pa po the kor (rgya gar )dang / sheg se pir (dbyin ji ) mo po sang (gla — 242 —
ran si )chi kho spru (khu ru su ) mag thu 'un (a mi ri kha )thu khe nye spru (khu ru su ) phi lan te lud (i ṭa li ) bcas kyi phul byung brtsams chos bod rigs klog pa pos mjal ba'i go skabs thob pa red/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom pa po tshos phul byung brtsams chos de tshor gzigs te gsar rtsom gyi blo 5stobs bskyed nas dus yun thung ngu zhig nang snying rus chen pos brtsams sgrung thung gras dang / rang mos snyan ngag la sogs pa'i rig rtsom brtsams chos mang po gsar rtsom 5 gnang yod/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i dus 'gor brtsams sgrung thung gras 〈〈mdun sgo chen mo〉〉〈〈mi lam 〉〉〈〈sgyu ling rta pho'i rmig sgra〉〉〈〈spo bo tshe ring la go 'dzol byung ba 〉〉〈〈skyid grong rnying pa'i gnyen sgrig 〉〉〈〈spo bo dbyangs can dpal mo'i ming 'grel 〉〈〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung 〉〉la sogs thon yod pa de dag gi nang don dang rnam pa/ rtsom gyi sgrung gzhi dang bskrun bya'i mi sna/ rjod byed tshig sbyor dang mi sna'i dbar gyi gling brjod la sogs pa rtsom rig gi grub cha gang nas bltas kyang brtsams sgrung de dag dngos mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom thabs spyad pa ha cang gsal po red 'dug pas gong du zhus ma thag pa'i 'dzam gling grags can gyi rtsom pa po tsho'i phul byung rig rtsom — 243 —
brtsams chos kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod pa zur bltas leb mthong yin/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom pa po tshos brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung thung gras de tsho'i nang bsgrun pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan gson nyams dod cing / sgrung gi thog mtha' bar shāgsum bkod 'bri byed stangs lugs dang mthun la tshags dam pa/ rjod tshig go bde zhing don gsal ba ma zad/ spros pa rgyas po min par bab chags pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi yon rtan du ma ldan 'dug pas na brtsams chos de tshos bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi lam bu yangs shing rgya che ba zhig gtod 'dug snyam/ 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb thog phyi rgyal gyi phul byung brtsams chos sgyur ma spel yod pa ma zad/ rgya rigs kyi phul byung rig rtsom brtsams chos 〈〈khang chen dmar po'i mi lam〉〉nang gi le'u btams te bod yig thog phab sgyur byas nas bkod yod pa dang / bod rigs5kyis rgya yig thog nas brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈stes dbang du gson pa'i mi〉〉dang 〈〈skal bzang me rko tog〉〉nang gi le'u re zung bod yig tu phab sgyur byas te5bkod yod pa ma zad/ da dung brtsams sgrung thung gras 〈〈rlung rta'i gzi 'od〉〉dang 〈〈'khor ba'i nyin mo 〉〉bod yig thog phab bsgyur byas te bkod yod pa de tshos bod kyi deng dus4— 244 —
gsar rtsom bya bar shugs rkyen gting zab thebs rgyu red/lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'gor rtsom pa po dpal 'byor gyis bod yig nas brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈gtsug g.yug〉thon pa'i rjes su spyi lo 1990lor rtsom pa po bkra shis dpal ldan gyis brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈phal pa'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉 (bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe spun khang nas bton ) thon zhing / de nas lo shas ma song bar rtsom pa po lhag pa don grub kyi brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈'pho 'gyur〉〉dang rtsom pa po brag gdong bkras gling dbang rdor gyi brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈bkras zur tshang gi gsang ba'i gtam rgyud 〉〉de gnyis 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉〉dus deb thog bstud mar 'god mus yin/bod yig thog nas brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras bzhi po de'i brjod gzhi bod kyi 'tsho ba yin zhing / brjod bya'i 'tsho ba ga'i rgya che la gting zab pa'i khyad chos chen po ldan yod stabs brtsams sgrung du bkod pa'i 'tsho ba de tshos klog pa por bden nges dang dus rabs kyi tshor snang zab mo zhig ster gyi yod/ brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈bkras zur tshang gi gsang ba'i gtam rgyud〉〉dang 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉gnyis por sgrung gzhi bkod 'bri ngo mtshar che la rjod byed tshig sbyor bde — 245 —
zhing / snyan pa'i khyad chos ldan 'dug cing / brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈phal pa'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉dang 〈〈'pho 'gyur 〉〉gnyis por brtsams sgrung du bkod pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan gson nyams dod cing / 'bri bya'i 'tsho ba mngon sum gson rjen yin pa'i tshor snang zhig ster gyi 'dugbrtsams spung ring gras bzhi po de ni bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig khrod du bod rigs kyi rtsom pa pos bod yig thog nas bod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon par byas pa'i rig rtsom brtsams chos pasna nypha ṭwāṃ pa༈ smra sna ṭā ṭwāṃ ༈ (golha dā dā 〉pa /sdi dī spri shā rgyus bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig la khyon yongs kyi phyogs nas bltas na gong 'phel 'gro tshad dal po min zhing /'phel rgyas 'gro stangs brtan po yin pa'i myong tshor zhig yong gi 'dug 'on kyang de tsam la blo yid tshim na gtan nas mi 'grig gang lags she na grangs nyung mi rigs ga'an gyi deng dus rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la blta dus nga tsho bod rigs kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi thog ma 'go tshugs pa'i dus tshod kho tsho las phyi ba yod cing / nga tsho'i mdun du da dung mu mthud dar rgyas gong spel gtong rgyu'i gnas don kha tsha dgos gtugs shig lhag yod pas de ni chu mo'i gyen la ko gru — 246 —
gtong ba lta bu mdun du bskyod mi thub na rang shugs su rgyab tu lus rgyu nyag cig yin/ der brten bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel gtong ba la rig rtsom brtsams chos gsar rtsom gyi bya bar 'go yag po khrid rgyu dang / der sems khur lhod med bya rgyu/ bod mi rigs khyon yongs kyi shes rig slob gso'i bya bar shugs snon brgyab ste mi rigs de ga'i rig gnas byang tshad gong mthor gtong rgyu/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum gyi las kur shugs snon ngo ma rgyag rgyu bcas ni ma mtha'i cha rkyen yin pa'i thog byang tshad mtho ba'i lo tsā'i dpung khag gcig gso: skyong byas nas rgyal nang rgyal phyi/ gna' dus deng dus bcas kyi phul byung rig rtsal brtsams chos 'bor chen bod yig tu phab sgyur dpe bsgrun bya rgyu de'ang med du mi rung ba'i gal che'i cha rkyen zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig dang deng dus rtsom rig gis bskyod zin pa'i lam bur phyir bltas byas na phul byung rig rtsom brtsams chos bod yig tu phab sgyur dpe bskrun bya rgyu'i las ka de ni bod rigs kyi rtsom rig dar rgyas gong spel gtong ba la snang chung hod rgyugs mi rung ba'i bya ba gal che zhig yin pa'i dngos ra gsal po 'phrod zin pa red/— 247 —
bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang tshun bod kyi yig sgyur bya gzhag ni bya gzhag ga'an pa'i sngon du bskyod nas grub 'bras chen po thob ste lo tsā ba mang po gso skyong byas nas srid don dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ slob gso/tshan rig lag rtsal bcas kyi thad la yig sgyur 'bor chen byas te bod kyi ñtsha tshogs ring lugs gsar brje dang spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs sgrun la legs skyes gzengs su thon pa phul yod/ de dang 'dra ba bod kyi rtsom rig yig sgyur thad la'ang 'das rin pa'i lo ngo bzhi bcu'i ring / rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi las rigs thog phul byung gi bsgyur rtsom mang po dpe skrun byas yod/ 〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud 〉〉cha tshang sgyur ma/ 〈〈khang chen dmar po'i rmi lam 〉〉gyi bsgyur khag gnyis/ 〈〈rgyal khab gsum gyi gtam rgyud 〉〉cha shas sgyur ma la sogs phul byung gna' rtsom khag cig dang / ma'o tsi tung gi snyan tshig sgyur ma/ gnam bde sgo mo'i snyan tshig bshu deb sgyur ma bcas deng dus snyan rtsom khag cig da dung lo rabs brgyad cu'i rjes su 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb dang / 〈〈lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb/ 〈〈zang char〉〉dus deb la sogs pa'i bod yig dus deb khag la bkod pa'i mdzam gling grags can gyi brtsams chos sgyur ma bcas — 248 —
yod/ de dag dpar bsgrun 'grems spel byed thub pa de ni rtsom rig yig sgyur bya bar grub 'bras chen po thob pa'i rtags mtshan yin/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs dgu bcur slobs dus krung go'i bsgyur bcos sgo dbye sngar bas gting zab tu phyin yod cing / 'dzam gling gi tshan rtsal dang /'khrims 'grul/ 'phrin gtong lag rtsal bcas 'phel rgyas shugs che phyin pa dang / rgyal khab phan tshun dbar dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spel res sngar bas shugs cher 'gro ba/ mi rnams kyis rang gcig pu las bsam rgyu med pa'i 'khor rgya chung chung de nas brgal te mi'i rigs kyi shes rig bang mdzod la legs skyes 'bul rgyu'i tshad mtho'i dmigs tshad zin nas 'bad brtson byed kyi yod/ dus bab kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog chen po 'di lta bu 'gro ba'i skabs su mi tsho'i bsam blo'i nang lo tsā'i bya ba gal 'gangs chen po yin pa'i ngos 'dzin rang shugs su yong gi yod la lo tsā bar yar rgyas 'gro ba'i go skabs bzang po zhig 'phrad pa dang chabs cig g.yol thabs med pa'i 'gran skul zhig kyang yong mus yin/des na yig sgyur bya ba de sngar thob zin pa'i grub 'bras la yid rangs nas bsdad na ga nas 'grig slad phyin gyi yig sgyur bya ba ni rig pa'i gnas mang po dang / skad rigs mang — 249 —
po la kha phyogs dgos/ yig sgyur bya bas de 'dra zhig byed thub na deng skabs mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas 'gro mus yin pa'i dus bab kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams thub/ yig sgyur bya ba hril po'i nang gal che'i gnas bab bzung yod pa'i rtsom rig yig sgyur bya gzhag kyang de sngon gyi rnam par gyur ldog btang ste sgrigs 'dzugs yod pa dang / 'char ga'i yod pa/dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas 'dzam gling phul byung gi rig rtsom brtsams chos khag cig cha tshang po'i sgo nas bod yig thog phab bsgyur dpar bskrun byed thub na dus tshod ring po ma 'gor bar grub 'bras chen po thob rgyu nyag cig red snyam gyi 'dug da lta'i dus su'ang 'dzam gling grags can gyi brtsams sgrung ring gras bod yig thog phab bsgyur dpe skrun byas pa'i dpe deb gcig kyang mjal rgyu med pa'i gnas stangs ya nga po de 'dra mgyogs nas myur du 'gyur ldog gtong dgos/ 〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉〉cha tshang bod yig thog phab sgyur dpe sgrun byas te da cha bod kyi klog po po'i khrod du 〈〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i 〉〉sgrung lta bu khyab gdal phyin yod/ 〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud 〉〉kyi sgrung ga'i 'khrug cha dod cing / 'bri bya'i mi sna so po'i rang gshis mngon gsal dod pa/ rjod tshig snyan cha dod pa/ 'bri bya zhib tshags pa la sogs — 250 —
pa'i sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis bod rigs rtsom pa po'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog gi yod/ 'dzam gling phul byung gi rig rtsom brtsams chos mang po zhig bod yig thog phab sgyur gyis dpe bsgrun 'grems spel byas na mi rigs gzhan pa'i phul byung rigs gnas mtshams sbyor ngo sprod byed thub rgyu smos ci/ lhag par du bod mi rigs kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi brda sprod tshig brda phun sum je tshogs su gtong rgyur phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yong rgyu nyag cig red/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi brda sprod tshig brda cha tshang po med pa'i rkyen gyis bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyur 'gog rkyen chen po bzo yi yod/ gnad don de thag gcod byed pa'i thibs lam bzang shos ni rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul byung rig rtsom brtsams chos mang po bod yig thog phab sgyur byas te dpar bsgrun 'grems spel bya rgyu de yin/ u ru su'i rlabs chen gyi snyan ngag mkhan po phu shi cin gyis phul du zung ba'i snyan rtsom du ma brtsams te 'dzam gling rig gnas bang mdzod nang rtsa che'i nor bu legs skyes su phul yod pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags/ snyan ngag mkhan po khong gis de las lhag pa'i rlabs che'i phyag rjes ba'ag yod pa de ni khong gi sku tshe'i ring yu ru su'i rtsom rig gi brda — 251 —
sprod tshig brda'i rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan pa zhig bting thub pa de'i drin gyis khong gi rjes su u ru su'i grags can rtsom pa po mang po zhig thon yod pa red/ gal te de snga nas 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag gi phul byung rig rtsom brtsams chos mang po bod yig thog bsgyur te dpe bsgrun 'grems spel byas yod na/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi rnam pa de da lta'i de 'dra yin srid kyi ma red/ des na rtsom rig yig sgyur bya bas deng dus rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyur phan nus chen po thon gyi yod pa ha cang gsal po red/'dzam gling gi yig bsgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs zhib 'jus mdzad mkhan mkhas pa mang pos brtson pa lhod med kyis yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la dpyad zhib gnang yod rung / yig bsgyur spyi la khyab pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig mjal rgyu dkon par snang / de la rgyu mtshan sna tshogs shig yod kyang / kho bos bltas na gal 'gangs che ba'i rgyu mtshan zhig ste yig bsgyur zhes pa'i rig pa'i gnas de nyid gnam ris rig pa dang / rtsis rig pa/ sa khams rig pa la sogs pa'i rang tshugs thub pa'i tshan tshan rig pa de tsho dang mi 'dra bar yig sgyur gyi rig pa'i gnas de ni skad yig rig pa dang / rtsom rig pa dang / sher rtogs — 252 —
rig pa/ yul srol goms gshis rig pa la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas mang po dang 'brel nas yod cing / yig sgyur bya rim de ni lo tsā bas rig pa'i gnas mang po khong du chud nas yang dag bed spyod byed pa'i bya rim 'ig yin par brten yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thad nas yig sgyur la bzhag pa'i mtshan nyid kyang gcig la nges ga la thub/yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs 'ib 'jug mkhan la las 8 yig sgyur zhes bya ba de ni skad brda'i 'go mjug mthud sbyor gyi tshig brda rnams nang don nam don gyi snying por 'gyur ba med pa'i sgo nas skad brda'i 'go mjug mthud sbyor byas pa'i tshig brda ga'an zhig la 'gyur ba'i bya rim yin ji zhes gsungs/ sdom tshig de ni skad yig rig pa'i thog nas byung ba'i sdom tshig cig yin pa gsal po red/yang la las 66yig sgyur zhes bya ba de bsam blo'am don spyi 'ig skad yig gam rig gnas kyi rnam pa de nas skad yig gam rig gnas kyi rnam pa gzhan zhig la spo ba'i rgyud rim zhig yin 7zhes gsung pa de ni skad yig rig pa'i 'khor rgya las grol te rig pa'i gnas 'ga' shas la dgongs gzhigs gnang ste byung ba'i sdom tshig cig red/ yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lusas la 'ib 'jug mkhas can a ri ba — 253 —
ne ḍā yis 8 yig sgyur zhes pa de ni ma yig gi tshig don bang rtsom nyams rnams bu yig nang shin tu 'jug cing rang bzo'i (sgyur pa po ) g.ya' tsam med pa'i gcig mtshungs kyi tshig brda'i thog nas ma yig gi sprod bya'i brda rnams bu yig tu skyar du thon thub dgos pa de yin nyazhes gsung yod/sdom tshig de 'dra 'ig ba'ag pa dang chabs cig khong gis sdom tshig nang gsal ba'i 'gag rtsa'i tha snyad ri gnyis la 'grel pa de 'dra 'ig bskyon 'dug ( bsdoms tshig nang gsal rang bzo'i g.ya' tsam med pa zhes pa de sgyur byed bu yig klog dus bsgyur bya'i ma yig klog pa lta bu'i myong tshor sprod dgos pa las sgyur yig klog pa'i myong tshor med pa bzo dgos pa de la go dgos 7de ni bsgyur zin pa'i bu yig de sgyur byed bu yig klog mkhan mi rigs de ga'i skad yig brda sprod kyi lam srol dang mthun dgos pa'i go don yin par sems/ 64 sdom tshig nang du gsal ba'i shin tu 'jug pa zhes pa'i go don ni bu yig nang rang bzo'i g.ya' tsam med pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog da dung bu yig thog spyod byed tshig brda'i go don rnams ma yig dang ji tsam nye ba de tsam gyis legs pa'i don bstan pa yin/ zu gcig mtshungs : zhes bya ba de ni srog lta bu yin zhing kho shin tu 'jug pa'am ’— 254 —
rang bzo'i g.ya' tsam med pa ji la sogs gang bshad kyang dmigs yul ni gcig mtshungs yong ba'i ched du yin/yig sgyur bya ba'i nang rbad de gcig mtshungs rtsa ba nas yong mi srid/ 'on kyang lo tsā bas 6shin tu 'jug cing / 6rang bzo'i g.ya' tsam med pa'i nya gcig mtshungs kyi tshig brda rnams sbyor rgyur 'bad brtson bya dgos pa yin ji zhes gsungs so/ gong gsal yig sgyur gzhung lugs thad kyi sdom tshig gsum po de'i nang kho bos bltas na a ri ba rna ḍā yis ba'ag pa'i sdom tshig de nyid tshan rig dang mthun 'ing /phyogs re ba'i lta ba'i nang lhung med pa zhig tu mthong gi 'dug rna ḍā yi sdom tshig la gzhigs te sgyur byed bu yig la tshad ga'i bzhi bton yod pa ni/ 66() don dag nor 'dzol med par bu yig thog 'khyol ba/phu'i ma yig gi nyams 'gyur mi nyams pa'i thog nas bu yig thog 'khyol ba/phu'i bu yig gi rjod tshig bde zhing sugra snyom pa 6)klog pa por sprad pa'i tshor snang gcig mtshungs nya bcas so/ klog pa por sprad pa'i tshor snang gcig mtshungs zhes pa de ni ma yig gi klog pa po dang bu yig gi klog pa po'i blo la sprad pa'i don rnams gcig mtshungs yin par go dgos pa yin snyam/ ne ḍā yis mu mthud gsal ston gnang bar 6 tshad gzhi de ba'i por — 255 —
slebs pa'i tshe na nang don dang rnam pa gnyis dbar sel thabs med pa'i 'gal ba zhig yongasred/ de'i skabs su rnam pas nang don la ma bstun na nang don gyis rnam par bstun dgos pa'i gnad don zhig thon gyi red/ spyir btang nas bshad na ma yig gi nang don mi 'gyur ba'i ched du mtshon byed kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong dgos/ nang don ni ang dang po yin/ yin na yang de 'dra gcig tu nges pa min/ skad yig gi lam nas pha rol por brda 'phrin sprod pa'i rigs yin phyin de'i nang don dang rnam pa gnyis ni phan tshun 'phral thabs med pa gong bu hril po zhig yin pa de gsal po shes dgos/ lhag par du rtsom rig gi yig sgyur skabs su nang don kho nar dmigs nas rnam par brtsi med gtong ba'i byed stangs des ma yig gi sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur bu yig tu ma thon par bu yig de nyid kha rgyu bro rgyu med pa zhig tu 'gyur gyi yod/ de bzhin rnam pa kho nar dmigs nas nang don brtse med gtong ba'i byed stangs des ma yig las ston pa'i don rnams bu yig thog ji ma ji bzhin ma thon par bu yig de nyid tshig gi sprod pa rgyas pa las don gyi snying po mi gsal ba zhig tu 'gyur srid/ lo tsā bas nang don dang rnam pa gnyis gcig 'gyur yin zhes pa dang / nang don gal che/— 256 go
rnam pa gal chung la sogs pa'i rtsa don de tshor go ba rengs po blangs rgyu med/ mtha' gtugs nas bshad na yig sgyur (lhag par du snyan ngag yig sgyur ) zhes pa'i bya ba de ni/gsar gtod kyi bya ba zhig yin pa las lugs dpar brgyab pa'i bya ba zhig gtan nas ma yin 7bka' mol dum bu de'i nang rtsom rig yig sgyur skor la bgro gleng gnad du 'phegs pa gnang yod/ rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi lag len ngo ma'i thog nas sku zhabs rna ḍā yis yig sgyur la bzhag pa'i sdom tshig de dang sdom tshig nang gsal tha snyad la 'grel pa bskyon pa de dag rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi chos nyid dang yongs su mthun zhing / phul byung gi yig sgyur rnams kyang chos nyid de las ma 'das so/ nga tshos 〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud 〉〉le'u bcu pa'i nang khod pa'i snyan ngag mkhan po su'u hres brtsams pa'i ga'as tshig dum bu de bod yig tu ji ltar bsgyur ba yin pa de la cig gzigs dang /〈〈dkar gsal zla ba ga dus 'char min skor/ chang dkar btegs te dgung sngon mthon por 'dri/ zla ba'i khyim gyi dus bzhi'i nam zla de/ gang du slebs min kho yis ga la rtogs/ mtho ris gnas kyi ga'al yas khang bzang der/rlung la bzhon te 'gro 'dod yod na yang / bar snang mthon — 257 —
po'i bsil zer grang ngad dag bzod par dka' bas de ru chas mi phod/ zla ba'i lha mos 'gyings nyams ldan pa'i ngang /nam mthongs gar gyi rtsed 'jor rol na yang / grogs su grib ma nyid las med pa na/ 'jig rten mi yi yul 'di'i do zla bral/ sa steng nyams dga'i khang bzang sge'u khung gi sa tig star rgyus khra yol phye ba na/ rdzi mar gos pa'i gnyid kyang yer ba'i mir/ bsil zer zla ba'i 'od snang rab tu 'phros/sa steng skye bo'i khrod kyi gnyen dang grogs/ kha gyes gdung bas mnar dus nam yin la/ zla ba khyod nyid gdung sems mi 'char bar/ rab dkar nya gang bzhin ras ngoms pa ci/mi la dga' skyo 'du 'bral zla ba la'ang / 'char nub 'phel 'grib yong ba zlog tu med/ e ma mi rnams nad med tshe ring du/ zla ba'i 'od snang dpal la rol bar smon/ (〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud 〉〉le'u sum cu par 'khod/)rnam pa'i thog nas dbye zhib byas na snyan tshig dum bu de ma yig rgya yig tu ga'as tshig yin pa las snyan ngag rtsom min/ ma yig thog gzhas tshig de tshigs rkang mi snyoms pa'i tshig dum bcu dgu las grub pa yin/ 'on kyang bod yig tu phab sgyur byed skabs tshig dgu re byas pa'i rkang grangs snyom pa'i tshigs rkang 24yis ma yig gi bstan bya'i don rnams tsho— 258 —
bu yig tu chad lhag med par bstan yod/ gal te gcig mtshungs zhes pa'i dgos 'dun de nyid mu tshugs mthar jiskyel byas na/ ma yig rkang grangs mi snyom pa'i gzhas tshig yin tshe bu yig kyang rkang grangs mi snyom pa'i gzhas tshig gi rnam pa yin dgos/ yin na'ang 〈〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud 〉〉kyi lo tsā bas bod yig tu rgya yig dang 'dra ba'i tshig gi rkang grangs mi snyom pa'i ga'as tshig 'bri srol chags med ba'in du gcig mtshungs kyi rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs byas na bu yig nyams chags 'gro rgyu yin pa gsal po shes te bu yig tu tshig gi rkang grangs snyoms pa'i snyan ngag gi rnam pa'i thog nas bstan bya'i ma yig gi don rnams bstan pa'i skabs su ma yig gi nang don chad lhag med pa'i sgo nas bu yig tu gsal ba ma zad/ ma yig gi rnam pa'i sgeg nyams kyang bu yig thog gzengs su thon yo da pas sku 'bas rna ḍā yis gsung pa ltar che spyir btang nas bshad na ma yig gi nang don mi 'gyur ba'i ched du mtshon byed kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong dgos/ nang don ni ang dang po yin/ 'on kyang de 'dra gcig du nges pa ma yin/ skad yig gi thog nas pha rol por brda 'phrin spyod dgos pa'i rigs yin phyin de'i nang don dang rnam pa gnyis ni phan tshun 'phral thabs med pa'i gong — 259 —
bu hril po zhig yin pa de gsal po shes dgos 9 zhes pa'i rtsa don de lag len thog legs par 'akaka yod/ de ba'in sku zhabs ne ḍā yis gong du drangs zin pa'i yig sgyur gyi tshad ga'i bzhi po de 'khyer nas sgyur yig dum bu der 'jal na sgyur yig de tshad ldan 'ig yin pa gsal po mthong thub/rig rtsom brtsams chos kyi nang don dang rnam pa'i dbar gyi 'brel ba nas bltas na kho bos sku 'bas rna ṭā yis bton pa'i lta ba de yang dag yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gcig mtshungs thon rgyur ma ltos par tshigs rkang re re bzhin phab sgyur byed pa'i sgyur stangs des ma yig gi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams rnams bu yig thog thon dka' ba yin la/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gcig mtshungs thon rgyu kho nar bsams te ma yig gi nang don la ma ltas pa'i sgrur rdzangs lhas yiha snan ñtsha ma mtha'i hahas 'dun dang rgyab 'gal 'gro yi yod/ der brten nang don dang rnam pa gnyis phan tshun 'phral thabs med pa'i gong bu hril po gcig yin par ngos 'dzin byas te phyogs gcig dam 'khyir byed pa'i sgyur stangs de gnyis ka dor dgos so snyam/ bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig yig sgyur bya ba'i nang sgyur stangs de rigs mang nyung la ma ltos par mthong rgyu 'dug rig gnas gsar — 260 —
brje'i dus skabs ni g.yon gyi bsam blo'i lam phyogs kyis phyogs yongs dbang bsgyur byas pa'i dus skabs yin/ de'i dus su ma'o ku'u zhi'i snyan rtsom bod yig thog phab sgyur byed skabs ma yig nang yig 'bru ga tshod yod pa de rang bod yig thog phab sgyur byed pa las yig 'bru gcig la yang snon 'phri spor gcog byed mi chog de ltar bsgyur ba'i 'bras bur sgyur byed bu yig bod yig tu gsal ba'i ma'o gru'u 'i'i snyan tshig la snyan ngag gi nyams spu tsam yang med par gyur/ de ni sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gcig mtshungs thon rgyu'i dgos 'dun brtsi med btang ba'i rkyen gyis yin/ de ni yig sgyur khrod kyi phyogs lhung gcig dang / deng skabs brnyan 'phrin 'khyab tshan mang po 'ig bod skad thog bsgyur ba de dag rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs gi dga' bsu chen po thob mus yin rung nga tshos yig sgyur gyi tshad gzhi'i thog nas le tshan sgyur ma de tshor 'ib dpyad cig gnang na de tsho'i khrod du'ang gnad don 'ga' shas mthong thub/ de tsho'i nang sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gcig mtshungs thon rgyu kho nar bsams te ma yig gi sprod bya'i nang don la mi ltos pa'i skyon cha 'ig mthong rgyu 'dug dper na brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan 〈〈pho gzhon mo gzhon 〉〉zhes bya ba'i nang na gzhon pho mo gnyis dbar gyi — 261 —
bgro gleng de 'dra 'ig 'dug khyed rang mgon po phyag drug dang / nga rang pad ma lag rdum ma red ji ces bya ba'i gtam gleng dum bu de hob ste nyan dus tshig nyung don gsal 'ing /bstan bya'i ma yig gi don dang he dpag chen po med/ 'on kyang 'ib par bsams tshe btam dpe dum bu de'i tshig rtsar bod 'ang khyab pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rnam pa mthong rgyu'adug pa de rgya rigs kyi deng dus na gzhon gnyis po'i kha nas brjod dus shin tu ma lan pas skad kyi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur legs po thon rgyu 'ag de las ldog ste mi sna'i snang brnyan la gnod pa'i rgyu ru 'gro yi 'dug snyam/ da dung brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan sgyur ma 'ga' shas 'dug pa de tsho ltad mo kho na'i cha nas bltas na skyon cher med kyang /yig sgyur bya ba'i thad nas zhib dpyad byas tshe bod skad la bsgyur ba de tsho phar rgya yig la skyar bsgyur byas na rgya yig gi thog ma'i nang don dang 'gab mtshungs thub e yong snyam pa'i bsam tshul yong gi 'dug de yang kho bos rgyun ldan bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan blta ba'i skabs su yid la dran 'char byung ba thol byung du gleng ba yin stabs tan tan don la ma gnas pa'i skyon dang nor 'dzol yong srid pas dgongs 'gal med pa zhu/ mtshams der kho bos — 262 go
mkhas pa rna ṭā yis gsungs pa'i bka' mol de 'dra zhig la rjes su yi rangs zhu yi yod/ khong gis gsungs don rtsom rig yig sgyur zhes pa de mthar gtugs nas bshad na gsar gtod bya rgyu las lugs dpar nang nas skyar skrun bya rgyu de 'dra zhig gtan nas min/da ni nga tshos rtsom gshis brjod pa'i skabs su babs yod/ nga tshos yig sgyur bya ba'i rgyud rim nang ma yig gi rtsom gshis nyams med gsal ston bya rgyu dang / sgyur yig la thun mong ma yin pa'i rang gshis zhig ldan dgos rgyur brtson len byed pa de yang yig sgyur tshad ldan 'ig gi ngos nas bshad na hod rgyugs su gtong mi 'os pa'i 'gangs che'i gnas don zhig yin/ rtsom rig gi rtsoms gshis ni phyogs gcig ma yin par phyogs mang po'i rgyu mnyam du tshogs te phyir mngon par byas pa'i snang tshul 'ig yin 'ing / rtsom gshis zhes par bye brag rang rang so sor yod pa'i gshis rgyud mngon gsal dod po ldan dgos pa yin/ yig sgyur skabs su ma rtsom gyi rtsom gshis de tsho gsal ston byed mi thub par lo tsā ba'i rang gshis kyis ma rtsom gyi rtsom gshis 'thus par byas na ma yig nyams chags med par bu yig thog gsal ba'i yig sgyur gyi ma mtha'i dgos 'dun las 'gal — 263 —
ba yin snyam/ yig sgyur skabs su ma rtsom gyi nang don nyams chags med par bu yig thog gsal dgos pa smos ci/ ma rtsom gyi gseng gseng khug khug yod tshad bu yig thog nyams 'a chagayo med par ston thub pa byung na ma rtsom gyi rtsom gshis gzhi nas bu yig thog gsal thub/ rtsom gshis zhes pa de ni stong pa mthong rgyu med pa zhig ma yin par rtsom gyi khyon yongs nas mngon par byed kyi yod/ rtsom rig gi brtsams chos zhig gi rtsom gshis ni rtsom pa pos rtsom yig de 'bri ba'i skabs su spyod par bya ba'i ming tshig tha snyad dang / ming tshig tha snyad de dag las grub pa'i brjod bya'i go rim las mngon par byas yod/ yig sgyur skabs rtsom pa po'i brjod bya'i go rim de dag bu yig thog gcig mtshungs phab pa la skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod 'ba' zhig la brten nas thag chod yod thabs bral te/ de ni lo tsā ba tshos brtson zhib byed sa'i5 'gag rtsa'i gnas shig yin pa red/ ma yig gi brjod bya bkod stangs myur dal tshad gzhi gang 'dra zhig yin par do snang byed dgos pa de'ang rtsom gshis dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnas don zhig yin/ rtsom pa pos rtsom yig nang 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i skabs su spyir btang rmang gzhi'i 'phel rim dang / 'bri bya'i mi sna'i dgos mkhor gzhigs te rjod tshig — 264 —
gi myur dal tshad gzhi btang 'dzin byed kyi yod pas lo tsā bas de gsal po rtogs te ma yig la gsal gang thub byed thub pa yin na da gzod ma yig gi rtsom gshis nyams chags med par bu yig thog 'khyol thub pa yin/ de bzhin ma yig nang gi 'bri bya'i mi sna'i gshis ka dang mthun pa'i brjod tshig dang / 'bri bya'i mi sna'i 9 tshogs thog gi gnas bab mi 'dra ba so so'i brjod tshig dus rabs so so'i skabs kyi brjod tshig dga' skyo chags sdang gi brjod tshig mi rigs so sor goms gshis su 'jags pa'i brjod tshig gtam dpe/kha rgyun la sogs bed spyod byed skabs 'os shing 'tshams pa dgos rgyur thugs snang chen po gnang dgos/ rig rtsom 5 brtsams chos kyi rtsom gshis kyi rgyu de tsho las grub pa yin/gal te lo tsā bas gnad don phra mo de tshor tod rgyugs btang na ma rtsom gyi rtsom gshis sgyur rtsom du thon dka'o/ kho bo'i bag chags su de snga mthong myong ba'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgyur ma kha shas la gnad don der yid 'jog med pa'i rkyen gyi lug gi mgo la ra'i rwa co bris pa lta bu'i ba'ad gad kyi rgyu thon 'dug snyam/ 'ib phra'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgyur ma de dang 'di zhes 'phral 'phral ming 'bod bya rgyu med rung /brnyan 'phrin le tshan la lar dpar ngos thog ye shu'i chos — 265 —
dpon zhig gi chos khang nang smon lam rgyag bzhin pa'i gzugs brnyan ston zhing / chos dpon gyi 'al nas bod skad du/ 6 dkon mchog thugs rjes gzigs/ bdag gyi khyed la smon lam rgyag gi yin nya zhes pa thon/ hob ste bltas na de la skyon cher med kyang / zhib par bsam dus na dkon mchog thugs rjes gzigs ’ zhes bya ba'i tshig de rna bar thos pa dang yid la smon lam rgyag mkhan mi de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mi zhig 'khor rgyu yin pa smos ci/ 'on kyang 'dren lam du gsal ba ni ye shu'u chos lugs kyi chos dpon zhig yin 'dug na de ni 'gal ba'i phyogs yin par sems/ yig sgyur ngos nas bshad na 6 dkon mchog gces pa'i ming de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dad rten gyi ched spyod tha snyad yin pa las chos lugs kyi dad rten smi la khyab pa min/ des na ye shu'i chos lugs kyi dad rten la tha snyad gzhan zhig 'dogs dgos/ dper na na gnam bdag chen po ji 'am yang na na bdag nyid chen po 7la sogs pa'i tha snyad btags pa'am yang na de las 'jug pa'i ming cang na rab/ ma byung na'ang ma mthar chos lugs rigs mi 'dra ba so so'i khyad chos tha snyad nas thon thub pa dgos/ gong gi sgyur stangs des mi sna'i spyi tshogs gnas babs kyi brjod tshig de nyid ma — 266 —
yig las gsal ba ji bzhin bu yig sgyur yig tu thon med pas de ltar na ma yig gi brjod bya'i don sgyur yig thog nor 'dzol med par ston ma thub pa'i khar/ sgyur gyi sgyu rtsal 5 nyams 'gyur la nyams chags chen po 'gro srid/ de lta bu'i sgyur stangs ni dor bya'i gnas yin par 'dod/mjug tu skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba'i skor gleng bar 'dod de sgyur spus shin tu dag pa'i yig sgyur zhig byed dgos na sgyur pa po lo tsā bar phyogs gang sa ci thad nas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i re ba mtho po 'ig 'don rgyu yin pa gor mi chag yig sgyur zhes bya ba'i las don de spyir nas bshad na skad yig gcig nas skad yig gzhan zhig la bsgyur rgyu de yin/ skad yig rigs gnyis phran tsam shes pa'i sgang la skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod cig byung na ha lam yig sgyur gyi las ka de sus byas kyang 'grig gi yod bzo 'dug don du yig sgyur las ka zhes bya ba spyi dang / lhag par tshad ldan rtsom rig yig sgyur zhig gi ngos nas bshad na de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma yin/ rtsom rig yig sgyur zhes pa de ni lo tsā ba'i gsar gtod kyi bya ba 'ig yin gshis/ lo tsā bas ma yig gi nang don dang rnam pa gnyis ka bu yig sgyur yig thog ji ma ji bzhin thon gang thub byed dgos/ de ni ma rtsom klog — 267 —
skabs thon dgos pa yin/ der brten sgyur pa por bu yig gi chu tshad mtho po ldan dgos pa gling med thog sgyur gyi bya bar dngos su zhugs pa'i skabs su rang gi khong du chud rin pa'i bu yig phun sum tshogs po de dag gi 'od nas ma yig gi don dang shin tu 'tshams pa/ shin tu 'os pa'i tshig brda rnams spyad de rig rtsom gyi brtsams chos gsar pa zhig skyar du bskrun dgos pa de yin/ der brten lo tsā ba 'ga' shas la myong tshor de 'dra byung myong / 66 lo tsā ba yag shos ni khong gi bsgyur bya'i rtsom yig dang rigs mthun pa'i brtsams shāchos rtsom myong mkhan gyi rtsom pa po de red/ snyan ngag sgyur yag shos kyi lo tsā ba de snyan ngag gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras thon myong ba'i snyan ngag mkhan po de red/7 khong rnam pa'i bka' mol de tshor gnas lugs rgyu mtshan rtsa ba nas med pa ga la yin/yig sgyur bya ba ni skad yig rigs gcig nas skad yig rigs gzhan zhig la phab sgyur bya rgyu'i las ka yin 7stabs ma yig la go ba gting zab lon thub min gyis sgyur yig gi spus tshad dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa yin/ ma yig la go ba ji tsam zab pa lon thub na bu yig thog ma yig mtshon skabs bkag rgya ji tsam chung ba yod la sgyur yig gi — 268 —
zhus tshad kyang de tsam gyis mtho ba yong / ma yig la nor 'dzol med pa'i sgo nas go ba zab mo lon rgyu de sgyur spus dag yong ba'i lam dang po de yin/ des na ma yig gi rtsa ba'i khyad chos dang / ma yig gi gseng gseng khug khug zhog lkog ngos ngos cha tshang chad lus med par go ba blangs rgyu de shin tu nas gal che/ma yig dang bu yig gnyi ka khong du chud dgos pa ni lo tsā'i ma mtha'i cha rkyen yin zhing / de'i steng du rang gi bsgyur bya'i rig pa'i gnas gang yin pa de la rgyus mnga' che tsam dgos shing / de dang 'brel ba'i rig pa'i gnas gzhan la'ang cha rgyus gang tsam dgos/ dper na rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi lo tsā ba zhig la cha bzhag na lo tsā bas rtsom rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi shes tshad mtho tsam yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog gye brag rig rtsom brtsams chos shig bsgyur ba'i skabs su ma rtsom gyi brjod byar bkod pa'i 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' yod dgos/ ma rtsom gyi brjod gzhi de bod kyi smyu tshogs rnying pa'i sku drag 'tsho ba bkod yod na sgyur pa pos skabs de'i 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' mthong thos yod dgos/ de dang 'dra ba ma rtsom gyi brjod ga'ir bod kyi chos lugs bkod yod na sgyur pa pos bod la dar ba'i nang — 269 —
pa sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dang bod kyi dgon pa'i 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' yod dgos/ cha rkyen de tsho sgyur yig sprus dag yong rgyur med du mi rung ba yin/ de yang bsgyur bya 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' med pa'i mis yig bsgyur bya ba la 'jug mi chog pa'i lta ba rengs po de 'dra 'dzin gyi med/ kho bos brjod par 'dod pa'i don gyi snying po ni sgyur yig spus dag cig yin dgos na cha rkyen de dag 'dzoms dgos so zhes pa de yin/ nga tshos mig sngar mthong thos su gyur ba'i sngar gyi bsgyur yig dpe cha de tsho ma rin la zhu dag gnang ba'i skabs su phyi'i skad yig byang chub pa'i lo tsā ba dang bod kyi skad yig byang chub pa'i zhud chen lo tsā ba lhan du zhib bsher gtan la phab pa sha stag yin pas sgyur yig de rigs kyi spus ka rtser son pa yin pa la som nye ci/rtsom rig yig sgyur lo tsā bar gong du zhus pa'i cha rkyen de dag ldan dgos pa'i khar rab byung na lo tsā ba de rang rig rtsom gsar rtsom gyi bya bar zhugs myong yod dgos/brtsams sgrung yig sgyur gnang mkhan yin na lo tsā ba des brtsams sgrung re gnyis 'bri myong yod dgos/ snyan ngag yig sgyur gnang mkhan yin na lo tsā ba des snyan rtsom re gnyis 'bri myong yod dgos/ rig rtsom brtsams chos sgyur pa po zhig — 270 —
gi ngos nas bshad na cha rkyen de ni ha cang gal chen po yin par mthong gi 'dug rtsom rig thad kyi mkhas dbang snyan grags can sku zhabs lu'u shun dang / sku zhabs ko mo ru la cha bzhag na khong rnam gnyis grags can rtsom pa po yin la lo tsā ba yang yin/ bcu phyag rig gnas la mkhas shing/ pa3 ta'i mtshan snyan thob pa'i sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan mchog gis 〈〈sa skya legs bshad 〉〉brtsams te legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom srol gyi sgo mo 'byed pa yin la mkhas dbang mchog ni 〈zhwa ta la shin tu mkhas pa'i skad gnyis smra ba yin/ mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal mchog gis bod kyi grags can gna' rtsom 〈〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 〉〉ljags rtsom gnang ste mi rabs rjes mar phyag rjes bzhag gnang yod pa ma zad/ khong gi 〈〈bod skad dang legs sbyar skad gnyis shan sbyar 〉〉gyi dpe cha legs sgrig gnang yod/rtsom rig yig sgyur yag po zhig byed dgos na yig sgyur gyi zhor du rig rtsal gsar rtsom byed dgos/ rig rtsal gsar rtsom don gnyer byas pa des khyed kyi yig sgyur las kur phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ de bzhin rig rtsal gsar rtsom yag po zhig byed dgos snyam na yig sgyur gyi las ka byed dgos pa yin/ yig sgyur gyi las ka don gnyer byas pa des — 271 —
khyed kyi gsar rtsom gyi lam bu rgya che ru gtong thub/ der brten yig sgyur dang gsar rtsom zhes pa'i las ka de gnyis phan tshun 'gal ba min par de gnyis phan tshan gcig phan gcig rogs/ phan tshun kha gsab thub pa'i 'brel ba zhig yin pa de sngar gyi mkhas pa tshos phebs zin pa'i 'gro lam la bltas na gsal po mthong thub pa yin/mdor na yig sgyur zhes pa'i bya ba de ni rigs mi 5mthun pa'i skad yig gnyis dbar 'brel zam 'dzugs —mkhan zhig yin pas de ni tshan tshan rig pa mtha' dag gi sngon du 'gro dgos mkhan rig pa'i gnas zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gyed kyi yod/ lhag par deng skabs bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i srid jus gting zab lag bstar byed pa'i skabs su spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur yig sgyur ni gzhan las lhag pa'i dgos mkho che ba yin pa'i ngos 'dzin rim bzhin yong gi yod/ yig sgyur zhes pa'i bya ba de rmang gzhi'i las ka zhig yin pas yig sgyur spus tshad legs nyes kyis bsam blo gsar pa dang / lta tshul gsar pa/ tshan rig gsar pa bcas khyab gdal yang dag gtong thub min la thad kur 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin/ der brten yigasgyur sus tshad gong mthor gtong rgyu'i las ka de shin tu nas gal che bar snyam/ yig — 272 —
sgyur zhes pa'i bya ba de lag len kho na'i khrod nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i rig pa'i gnas shig yin pa'i rkyen gyis 6 skad yig gnyis shes mkhan yod tshad kyis yig sgyur byed thub ’pa dang che yig sgyur ni gsar gtod ma yin 7snyam pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta tshul yong srid pas don dngos dang ma mthun pa'i phyogs re'i lta ba de rigs kyis yig sgyur bya ga'ag yar rgyas gong spel gtong rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs srid pas lta tshul de rigs nges par yo bsrangs byed dgos/ yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs zhib 'jug byed pa'i skabs su 'ib 'jug gnang mkhan so po'i lta phyogs mi 'dra ba'i thog nas zhib 'jug byas te sdom tshig sna tshogs thon srid pa des yig sgyur spyi la khyab pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhig 'grub thub thabs med/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas yig sgyur zhes pa de nyams myong kho nar brten te yig sgyur gyi spus tshad nyams myong gi rgya srang steng du 'degs te legs nyes dbye 'byed byed pa'i gnas tshul thon srid pas des deng dus kyi yig sgyur bya ga'ag yar rgyas gong spel gtong rgyur 'gog rkyen chen po bzo yi red/ der brten yig rgyur zhib 'jug gnang mkhan shes ldan tshos ma lag cha tshang 'ing / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung — 273 —
lugs kyi ga'al yas khang bzang zhig bskrun rgyu'i thugs re chen po gnang gi yod la de'i ched du 'bad brtson lhod med gnang pus yin/ spyi lo'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i mtshams su bod ljongs lha sa grong khyer du rgyal yongs kyi rang ba'in ldan pa'i bod rgya yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lusas kyi zhib dpyod tshogs 'du zhig bskong 'tshogs gnang ba de la don snying shin tu chen po ldan yod cing / des 'byung 'gyur bod kyi yig sgyur bya ga'ag gong spel gtong rgyur bag chags gting zab 'jog rgyu yin par yid ches chen po zhu ba'in yod pa bcas so/
bod ljongs rig rtsal lhan tshogs kyis gtso gnyer byas pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsam chos ched 'god dus deb 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉zhes pa 'di spyi lo 1980lor dbu brnyes pa nas da bar lo ngo bcu bzhi 'das zin/ de'i ring deb grangs brgyad bcu tag tag bton zin pa der rtsom gshis kyi rnam pa mi gcig pa'i brtsam chos yig 'bya ka lnga brgyar nye ba yod cing / rtsom yig spel thengs chig stong drug brgya lhag tsam yod pa des bod rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi ga'i khyon rtsa ba'i cha nas grub pa red/ lo bcu bzhi'i ring grub 'bras mang po thob yod rung grub 'bras che shos ni bod rigs sa khul du rgan dar gzhon gsum las grub pa'i rtsom pa po'i dpung khag cig dang / rtsom rig yig sgyur gyi dpung khag cig dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i dpung khag cig bcas 'tshar long yong bzhin yod pa de yin/ khong rnam pa'i ngal ba khyad bsad/ brtson pa lhur len gyi snying — 275 —
stobs 'dis 'das zin pa'i lo zla'i nang byas rjes dpag tu med pa ba'ag yod la 'byung 'gyur bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gra rgyas phun sum tshogs su btang nas rgyal phyi rgyal nang du snyan grags kyi ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo thub rgyur med du mi rung ba'i cha rkyen gtso bo bslun pa yin/ lo ngo bcu bzhi ring 'ing chen rim pa'i bod yig gi brtsam chos ched 'god dus deb 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉gyis gtso byas pa'i bod yig dus deb mang po gsar du thon yod pa de tsho nas gces bsdus byas pa'i rtsom rig gi deb rkyang pa mang po dpe bskrun khang khag nas dpar skrun 'grems spel byas yod pa des nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom rig 'di nyid ga'i khyon dang spus tshad gnyis thad nas sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi rjes su bsnyegs ba'in yod la la lar mi rigs gzhan gyi mdun du bskyod bzhin yod pa'i rnam pa bzang po zhig bstan pa de tsho mthong dus mi lo bcu bzhi rtsom sgrig gi las kur zad pa'i bdag lta bur dga' ba dang skul lcag brjod las 'das pa yong gi 'dug spyi lo 1985lor bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su dbu brnyes nas lo nyi shu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i skabs su bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bod rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi — 276 —
deb rkyang pa 〈〈brtsams sgrung gces bsdus 〉〉〈〈〈ga rtsom 5 gces bsdus 〉〉〈〈snyan rtsom gces bsdus〉〉bcas khag 5 gsum bton yod/ deb gsum po de'i nang rtsom pa po mang po'i phul byung rtsom yig gces bsdus byas yod pas de ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig 'di nyid thog ma'i ma lag 'grub bzhin yod pa'i mtshon rtags yin/ de nas lo lnga 'das pa'i rjes su bod zhi bas bzhings 'grol btang nas lo ba'i bcu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i skabs su bod dzongs rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyis rtsom pa po chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs dang / mkhas grub/ bkra shis dpal ldan/o rgyan rdo rje bcas mi bzhi po'i rtsom rig gi deb rkyang pa bzhi dpar bsgrun 'grems spel byas pa des bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig 'di nyid ma lag cha tshang grub pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog gom gang mdun du spos pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa red/ deng skabs bod ljongs rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyis 'gro dngul grabs gsog byas te rtsom pa po'i deb rkyang pa mu mthud 'don rgyu'i dgongs tshul yod mus yin pa de ni rtsom pa po tshor mtshon na gsar rtsom bya ba la skul 'ded chen po yin zhing / bod mi rigs hril po'i rig gnas gong spel gtong rgyur mtshon na bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes yin pas — 277 —
phran gyis snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rangs zhu bzhin yod/lo bcu bzhi'i ring bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig gi rtsom stegs thos brtsams sgrung ring ba khag gnyis thon zin pa gcig ni rtsom pa po dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉dang gcig shos ni rtsom pa po bkra shis dpal ldan gyi 〈〈phal pa'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉ces pa de gnyis yin/ da dung 'byung gyur gyi lo re gnyis nang brtsams sgrung ring gras kha shas thon rgyu yin pa'i bzo 'dug pas de tshos bod kyi deng dus rtsom rig ni thog ma med pa nas yod pa dang / yod pa nas phun sum tshogs su 'gro bzhin yod pa'i 'phel phyogs bstan pa red/bton zin pa'i deb nang da dung ljongs phyi khul gyi dpe skrun khang tshos dpar bskrun byas pa'i rtsom rig gi deb rkyang pa mkhas mchog dam pa don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈'bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengs 〉〉kyis gtsos pa'i deb mang po zhig 'dug ste phran la dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs ga dkon pa'i rkyen gyis re re bzhin bgrangs mi nus/ de tsho'ang deng dus bod rigs kyi rtsom rig stegs bu'i thog 'od snang 'bar ba'i nor bu sha stag yin/ 'phel phyogs de 'dra zhig la blta dus bod mi rigs kyi deng dus rtsom rig 'di nyid mu mthud yar ngo'i zla ba lta bu gong du 'phel bzhin pa'i rnam pa — 278 —
bzang po zhig bstan gyi 'dug snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhig kho bo'i blo la 'char gyi 'dug de 'dra yin 'dug na rang re'i rtsom pa po dang / klog pa po/ rtsom sgrig pa bcas kyisrig pa dngas gsal ngang 'phel phyogs 'di dbye zhib byas te go skabs bzang po dam 'dzin gyis rtsom rig bya ga'ag gra rgyas phun sum tshogs su gtong rgyur phyar ba spu 'degs gnang rgyu ni shin tu nas gal che snyam/kho bos mi lo bcu bzhi rtsom sgrig gi las ka byas te spyi lo 1993lo nas las ka 'di mjug 'gril te phyi lo nas bzung 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gi rtsom sgrig dbu 'dzin phran gyi de snga'i las rogs phyag sbrel blo mthun lhun grub rnam rgyal lags nas thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu red/ khong yang 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb thog ma dbu brnyes pa'i dus nas rtsom sgrig khang du phyag las gnang ste rtsom sgrig gi nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom sgrig pa bzang po 'ig yin stabs 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb grangs brgyad cu gya gcig pa nas dus deb 'di nyid sngar las lhag pa gnyer thub rgyur kho bos yid ches brtan po byed kyi yod/ skabs 'di dang bstun te de snga kho bos dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig 'go 'dzin byed ring / phyogs — 279 —
gang sa ci thad nas mthun 'gyur rogs ram gnang mkhan dbu khrid tsho dang / rtsom pa po tsho/ rtsom sgrig khang gi las 5rogs rnying pa tsho/ de bzhin las rigs khag dang ljongs phyi'i rtsom rig la dga' zhen yod pa'i grogs po tsho bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang sbrags slad mar yang 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dus deb la sngar bzhin rgyab skyor rogs ram mu mthud gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu rgyu yin/da cha bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i srid jus kyis gsar rtsom gyi khor yug bzang po bsgrun yod la ljongs rig rtsal lhan tshogs kyi dbu khrid tshos kyang bod yig gi gsar rtsom bya bar sngar las lhag pa'i thugs khur chen po mdzad kyi 'dug cing / rtsom sgrig khang du rtsom sgrig dbu 'dzin lhun grub rnam rgyal lags kyis gtsos pa'i rtsom sgrig pa tsho'i sems shugs chen po yod stabs rgya che'i dzongs phyi nang gi rtsom pa po tshos go skabs bzang po de 'dra skad cig tsam yang lhod g.yeng du mi shor bar dam por 'dzin nas gsar rtsom gyi snying stobs ches cher 'phel te gsar rtsom brtsam chos gna'i chu mo'i rgyun bzhin rtsom sgrig khang du gnang rtsol yod pa'i re skul de ni rtsom sgrig khang nas kha 'bral khar rgya che'i rtsom pa po tshor bcol ba'i sems nang gi re ba 'ba' zhig yin gshis lhan — 280 —
rgyas tshos thugs 'jags 'tshal/ mjug tu 'dzam gling gi yang rtse 'di ru rtsom rig gi jo mo glang ma zhig mgyogs nas myur du bzhengs grub thub rgyu'i smon 'dun dang bcas de snga'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gi rtsom sgrig 'go 'dzin gyi las khur ba phran tshe rdor pas spyi lo 1993lo'i zla 11tshes 17la/— 281 —
shes bya thor bu/rang re kha ba'i ljongs kyi bod rigs mi dmangs tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon gsal dod pa'i rgyun srol yu la goms gshis lugs mang po zhig yod pa de dag lo rgyus kyi dus rim ring po'i nang rim bzhin chags te da cha tshang mas khas blangs chog pa'i gnas tshul zhig tu 'gyur yod pa de la mi rigs ga'an gyis snang 'jog chen po byed pa dang zhib 'jug byed kyi yod/ lhag par phyi phyogs su sgo mo phyes pa'i deng gi dus su phan tshun rig gnas spel phyushugs je cher song yod pas nga tshos rang cag tsho'i rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang yang yang mthong rgyu yod kyang snang chung hod rgyugs su gtong ba'i yul goms gshis lugs chung rtsag khag cig yig thog tu bkod de mi rigs gzhan la mtshams sbyor ngo sprod zhu ba'i nus pa thon pa dang rang mi rigs nang khul du yul goms gshis lugs de dag dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thugs la 'jags thub na 'byung — 282 —
'gyur de rigs thor zhig dang ngo 'gyur mi yong ba'i phan pa shin tu chen po 'dug snyam pa'i kun slong gis bskul te phran gyis gnad don de rigs la dmigs nas mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog la bka' dri zhus pa'i zin tho legs bsgrigs kyis thengs 'di'i shes bya'i zegs ma'i le tshan du ngo sprod zhus pa yin/gro bsro phyemar/'bo dang / gro/ rtsam phye/ rtse sgro/ lo gsar me tog tshon ldan nas snye bcas las grub pa'i gro bsro phye mar zhes bya ba de ni bod kyi lo gsar la rten 'brel mtshon pa'i dngos po gal che 'ig yin/ bod kyi lo gsar skabs khyim tshang mi re ngo res gro bsro phye mar gsar du bzhengs te cha sgam steng du bsgrigs nas sku mgron phebs rim ba'in thog mar khyim bdag gis gro bsro phye mar btegs pa dang / mgron pos gro dang phye mar nas sne thog tsam byas te phud gtor dang sbrags 'al la mchod kyi yod pa de ni bod rigs kyis lo gsar la bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel mtshon par ris kyi yod/sngon chad gro bsro phye mar ni bod kyi lo gsar dang / bag ma gtong len gyi mdzad sgor bshams pa las de min byed sgor bshams srol cher med/ yin na'i deng dus gnam thang du rtsa — 283 —
che'i mgron po bsu skyel zhu skabs gro bsro phye mar dang / khrung phor btegs pa'i lugs srol mthong rgyu 'dug pa de tsho rten 'brel mtshon ched gsar du dar ba yin par sems/ phye mar gsar bzhengs skabs su phye mar 'bo'i nang gro dang / rtsam phye snga rting ji ltar 'jog rgyur mi mang pos snang chung hod rgyugs shor te gang rung bsgrig pa mthong rgyu 'dug pas don 'dir dmigs te mkhas pa rgan rabs tshor bka' slob zhus par khong rnam pas gsung na gro bsro phye mar ni bod mi rigs kyi bkra shis rten 'brel mtshon byed yin pas phye mar gsar bzhengs skabs su byis pa'i lag rtsed lta bu ma yin par nges par dang dod byed dgos/ de yang phye mar 'bo'i nang gi gro dang rtsam phye snga ting gtan 'khel gyis sngon la gro dang rjes la rtsam phye yin dgos/ gro ni kha bro po yong ba'i tshortags dang / rtsam phye ni lus 'tsho ba'i 'dud ri'i zas la longs spyod pa'i rten 'brel mtshon byed cig yin/ mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun de la gzhigs na gro bsro phye mar gsar bzhengs skabs su phye mar 'degs pa po'i lag g.yas pa'i phyogs su gro blugs rgyu dang / lag g.yon ma'i phyogs su rtsam phye blugs na snga rting go rim 'khrugs med pas lhan rgyas tsho'i thugs la de ltar nges na lo gsar la phye mar gsar bzhengs — 284 —
gnang dus phan pa che'o/daralcogbod kyi lo gsar skabs su gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang ba'i nyin mor thog gsol byed kyi yod/ de nyin snga dro grong pa khyim mtshes tshang ma bzhugs mkhar gyi yang thog steng bzhugs gral btang nas bsangs gsol byed pa dang sbrags dar lcog rnying pa phab ste gsar pa brje yi yod/ dar lcog ni dar lce dang / ba dan/ de gnyis 'dogs sa'i yul lcang gsar bcas las grub pa 'ig yin/ lcang gsar gyi kyug phran steng du tshos gzhi sngon po/ dkar po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ ser po bcas kyi ras lheb ma'i mtha' gcig la a yig gi dbyibs can dras pa de la dar lce zer/ de'i 'og la gong gi tshos gzhi lnga po'i nang gang rung gi tshos ga'i gcig yin pa'i ras gru bzhi mtha' bsgril dang ldan pa zhig gi ngos la zur ba'i stag seng khyung 'brug gi ri mo bkod yod cing / dbus su rta mchog cang shes kyi nor bu me 'bar 'khur ba'i ri mo bkod pa/ de'i steng rgyal ba'i bka' dpar du btab yod pa'i ba dan de la rlung bskyed dar lcog zer/ dar lce dang ba dan gyi tshos gzhi so sor mtshon bya re yod pas zhib par zhus na dar lce'i rtse mo tshos gzhi sngon pos nam mkha' mtshon pa — 285 —
dang / de 'og dkar pos sprin pa mtshon pa/ de 'og dmar pos me mtshon pa/ de 'og ljang gus chu mtshon pa/ de 'og ser pos sa mtshon pa bcas yin/ dar lcog steng de dag gi steng 'og go rim 'khrugs mi rung / dar lce'i 'og la ba dan yin zhing / ba dan gyi tshos gzhi ni khyim 'di'i bdag por gyur pa'i mi sna'i 'byung khams gang yin pa de la brten nas gtan 'khel ba yin/ khyim bdag gi khams lcags yin na ba dan tshos gzhi dkar po dang / khams sa yin na ba dan tshos ga'i ser po/ khams shing yin na ba dan tshos gzhi ljang gu/khams me yin na ba dan tshos gzhi dmar po/ khams chu yin na dan tshos gzhi sngon po bcas yin/ ba dan la mtha' 5 bsgril gtong dgos shing / mtha' bsgril gyi tshos gzhi dang ba dan gyi tshos gzhi gnyis gang rung sbyar mi chog de ni bod kyi 'byung rtsis las/ ma bu dgra grogs kyi skor 'go brtse srol yod cing / 'dir ma bu 'phrod pa gtso bor bcu dgos pa dper na 'byung khams shing yin pa'i ba dan gyi gzhi ljang gu la mtha' bsgril sngon po gtong dgos pa dang / 'byung khams me yin pa'i ba dan gyi ga'i dmar po la mtha' bsgril ljang gu gtong dgos pa/ 'byung khams sa yin pa'i ba dan gyi gzhi ser po la mtha' bsgril dmar po gtong dgos pa/ 'byung — 286 —
khams lcags yin pa'i ba dan gyi gzhi dkar po la mtha' bsgril ser po gtong dgos pa/ 'byung khams chu yin pa'i ba dan gyi gzhi sngon po lamatha' bsgril dkar po gtong dgos pa bcas khungs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dar lcog bzos na rlung rta yar bskyed kyi phan pa thon no snyam/nyam g.yungadrung]bod mi'i khang pa'i phyi sgo'i steng du nyi zla g.yung drung gi ri mo 'bri srol yod/ de ni sgo'i steng du mdzes rgyan ched du bris pa ma yin par dgos pa nges can yod/ g.yang sgrub las tshe yi nyi ma mi nub rab tu gsal/ bsod nams zla ba yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ rigs rgyud mi 'gyur g.yung drung ltar brtan pa/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog gong gi gsung tshul 'dir gzhigs na sgo'i steng gi nyi zla g.yung drung gi ri mos tshe ring ba dang / bsod nams 'phel ba/ rigs rgyud 'gyur ba med pa la sogs pa'i rten 'brel mtshon gyi yod pa gsal por shes thub bo/nor bu dga' 'khril/bod mi'i khang pa'i ka steng gi gzhu dang / de min rnga la — 287 —
sogs pa'i dngos po'i stong nor bu dga' 'khyil gnyis —ldan dang / gsum ldan/ bzhi ldan la sogs mthong rgyu yod/ri mo de tshos gang mtshon pa yin nam zhe na nor bu dga' 'khyil gnyis ldan gyis thabs dang shes rab mtshon zhing /nor bu dga' 'khyim gsum ldan gyis skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum mtshon pa/ nor bu dga' 'khyil bzhi ldan gyis dga' ba bzhi ste dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad dga'/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bcas mtshon pa yin/ri dwagasachos 'khor/nga tshos dgon sde khag la phebs dus thog mar 'dren byed yul du gyur pa ni dgon pa'i tshogs chen gyi yang steng du ri dgas pho mo gnyis kyis 6bas ma brgyad ldan gyi 'khor lo gcig la rtse gcig tu bltas nas sdod pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong rgyu 'dug pa de yang snying ci zhig mtshon pa yin/ de'i skor dge rgan chen mo dung dkar rin po che mchog la bka' dri zhus pas khong gis gsung na rtsibs ma brgyad ldan gyi 'khor lo ni sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te chos gsungs pa la g.yas g.yon ri dgas pho mo gnyis ni bse ru yin te byang chub sems dpa'i sems rgyud — 288 —
bzhi'i gras bse ru'i sems rgyud kyis chos rtse gcig tu nyan pa mtshon pa yin/ dbus kyi rtsibs ma brgyad ldan gyi 'khor lo ni bslab pa gsum gyi nang nas tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mtshon pa dang / bar gyi jibs ma brgyad po ni shes rab kyi bslab pa mtshon pa/ mtha'i mu khyud ni ting nge 'dzin gyi shābslab pa mtshon pa yin/ yang 'khor lo'i 4bas ma brgyad po des 'phags lam yan lag brgyad mtshon pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yod do cog bslab pa gsum dang / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad du ma 'dus pa med/ ri dwags pho mo gnyis thabs dang shes rab mtshon te thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i mtshon byed/ yang dbus kyi chos 'khor mdo'i mtshon byed dang / g.yas g.yon ri dwags gnyis po sngags kyi mtshon byed yin pas nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos ni mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i rtags mtshon pa yin/ mdor na ri dgas chos 'khor gyis theg pa chen po'i chos dar 'ing rgyas pa'i rtags mtshon zhing / de ni nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rtags ma lta bu yin/de yang 'dzam gling thog chos lugs dang / tang shog rgyal khab so sor rtags ma yod pa lta bu'o/ —— 289 —
